def preq_submitted_before_de_proc_wf(self):
        try:
            pendingList = dict()
            pendingList_d = {}
            pendingList_l = []
            query = """SELECT 
            pb.workflow_number,
            pd.preq_number,
            DATE_FORMAT(pd.creation_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS creation_date,
            pd.description,
            pd.created_by,
            pd.status,
            wf.title,
            wplan.timestamp,
            _preq_log.last_update,
            IF(v_e.resolved = 1, 'Yes', 'No') AS resolved,
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS now_info,
            e.name as creator,
            _alias_dwl.workflow_emails,
            bsh.stakeholder_wf_email 
            FROM
            bom_database.preq_approval_plan pap
                JOIN
            (SELECT 
                pl.preq_number, pl.last_update
            FROM
                bom_database.preq_approval_plan_log pl
            WHERE
                pl.id IN (SELECT 
                        MAX(id)
                    FROM
                        bom_database.preq_approval_plan_log
                    GROUP BY preq_number)) AS _preq_log ON _preq_log.preq_number = pap.preq_number
                JOIN
            cifa.po_workflow pb ON pb.preq_number = pap.preq_number
                AND pap.workflow_id = pb.workflow_number
                JOIN
            cifa.workflow_plan wplan ON wplan.workflow_id = pb.workflow_number
                LEFT JOIN
            (SELECT 
                dwl.workflow_id,
                    GROUP_CONCAT(u.user_email) AS workflow_emails
            FROM
                bom_database.de_proc_workflow_log dwl
            JOIN bom_database.users u ON u.user_id = dwl.user_id
            GROUP BY dwl.workflow_id) AS _alias_dwl ON _alias_dwl.workflow_id = wplan.workflow_id
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(workflow_email) as stakeholder_wf_email, workflow_id  from
                        cifa.workflow_stakeholder) as bsh ON bsh.workflow_id = wplan.workflow_id
                JOIN
            workflow.workflow wf ON wf.id = pb.workflow_number
            LEFT JOIN workflow.entity e ON wf.requestor_entity =  e.id
                JOIN
            cifa.preq_details pd ON pb.preq_number = pd.preq_number
                LEFT JOIN
            cifa.violation_emails v_e ON v_e.workflow_id = wplan.workflow_id
                AND v_e.preq_number = pd.preq_number
            WHERE
            pd.status = 'INCOMPLETE' and 
            pd.delete_flag  = 0 and wf.active = 1
            and pap.status='cnss_approved'
            """  # b.bom_status >= 8
            rows = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")
            for row in rows:
                row = list(row.values())
                pending_dura = self.getWorkingDays(str(row[8]), str(row[10]), Holidays)
                pendingList_d = {'workflow_id': row[0], 'preq_number': row[1], 'creation_date': row[2],
                                 'description': row[3], 'created_by': row[4], 'status': row[5], 'title': row[6], 'plan_time': row[7], 'proc_phase2_plan': row[8], 'resolved': row[9],
                                 'pending_dura': float(pending_dura), 'creator': row[11],
                                 'workflow_emails': row[12], 'stakeholder_wf_email': row[13]}
                pendingList_l.append(pendingList_d)
            return pendingList_l
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

get_html_content.code:
def get_html_content(self, table_name):
        insert_result = {}
        status = False
        html_content = None
        additional_email_list = []
        try:
            query = f"""
                SELECT 
                    engineer,
                    requestorId AS engineer_id,
                    userName,
                    (SELECT 
                            user_email
                        FROM
                            bom_database.users
                        WHERE
                            user_login LIKE CONCAT('%', adName, '%')) AS userEmail,
                    supervisor,
                    SUM(multi_bom) AS multi_bom,
                    SUM(no_dns) AS no_dns,
                    SUM(no_bom) AS no_bom,
                    SUM(IF(multi_bom = 1 OR no_dns = 1
                            OR no_bom = 1,
                        1,
                        0)) AS issues,
                    COUNT(*) AS total,
                    SUM(IF(dateCreated > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 10 WEEK
                            AND multi_bom = 1,
                        1,
                        0)) AS multi_bom_recent,
                    SUM(IF(dateCreated > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 10 WEEK
                            AND no_dns = 1,
                        1,
                        0)) AS no_dns_recent,
                    SUM(IF(dateCreated > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 10 WEEK
                            AND no_bom = 1,
                        1,
                        0)) AS no_bom_recent,
                    SUM(IF(dateCreated > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 10 WEEK
                            AND (multi_bom = 1 OR no_dns = 1
                            OR no_bom = 1),
                        1,
                        0)) AS issues_recent,
                    SUM(IF(dateCreated > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 10 WEEK,
                        1,
                        0)) AS total_recent
                FROM
                    (SELECT 
                        IF(emp.AD_FIRST_NAME IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(emp.AD_FIRST_NAME, ' ', emp.AD_LAST_NAME), r.userName) AS engineer,
                            r.adName,
                            r.userName,
                            r.requestorId,
                            wo.dateCreated,
                            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUPERVISOR_NAME, ',', 1) AS supervisor,
                            IF(wo.dateCreated >= '2018-02-01'
                                AND bomCount > 1
                                AND bomList NOT IN (SELECT 
                                    CONCAT(parent_Bom_id, ';', GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT child_bom_id
                                            SEPARATOR ';')) AS bom_groups
                                FROM
                                    bom_database.parent_child_bom
                                WHERE
                                    child_bom_id != parent_bom_id
                                        AND child_bom_id != 0
                                GROUP BY parent_bom_id), 1, 0) AS multi_bom,
                            IF(has_dns IS NULL, 1, 0) AS no_dns,
                            IF(bomCount IS NULL, 1, 0) AS no_bom
                    FROM
                        filemaker2.wo
                    JOIN filemaker2.requestor r ON r.requestorId = wo.requestedBy
                    JOIN filemaker2.packingList pl ON pl.woNumber = wo.woNumber
                    JOIN filemaker2.woStep ws ON ws.stepId = wo.stepId
                    LEFT JOIN main.v_employees_contractors emp ON emp.AD_LOGIN_ID = r.adName
                    LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
                        wo, 1 AS has_dns
                    FROM
                        filemaker2.wo_dns wd
                    JOIN filemaker2.dns ON dns.dnsId = wd.dns
                    GROUP BY wo) AS dns ON dns.wo = wo.woNumber
                    LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
                        wo_number,
                            GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT bom_number
                                ORDER BY bom_number
                                SEPARATOR ';') AS bomList,
                            COUNT(bom_number) AS bomCount
                    FROM
                        filemaker2.wo_bom
                    GROUP BY wo_number) AS wb ON wb.wo_number = wo.woNumber
                    WHERE
                        wo.woPrefix = 'WO'
                            AND wo.dateCreated >= '2017-10-01'
                            AND CHAR_LENGTH(pl.serialNumber) > 4
                            AND (SUPERVISOR_PERNR IN (10105160 , 10069818, 10281906)
                            OR userName = 'nkim002c')
                            AND wo.stepId NOT IN (1 , 7, 13)
                            AND (title NOT LIKE '%uen%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%transport%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%transbom%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%transedp%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE 'NAT%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%-NAT%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%Fulfillment%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%domain controller%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%bi reporting%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%remediation%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%consignment%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%crate%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%blank%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%packing%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%filler%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%wifi%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%bushta%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%return%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%removal%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE 'aro%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%EOL SERVER%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%HP-SERVER%'
                            AND title NOT LIKE '%HPE %'
                            AND title NOT LIKE 'FULFILL%')
                    GROUP BY wo.woNumber) AS main
                GROUP BY engineer
                ORDER BY (SUM(IF(multi_bom = 1 OR no_dns = 1
                        OR no_bom = 1,
                    1,
                    0)) / COUNT(*)) DESC
            """

            results = self.iom_utils.get_pagination_result(query)
            if results:
                status = True
                insert_list = []
                for result in results:
                    insert_list.append({
                        "engineer": result.get('userName'),
                        "multi_bom": result.get('multi_bom'),
                        "no_bom": result.get('no_bom'),
                        "no_dns": result.get('no_dns'),
                        "total_issues": result.get('issues'),
                        "total_wo": result.get('total'),
                        "date_stamp": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                    })
                if insert_list:
                    result, duplicate_count, unique_count = self.iom_utils.insert_data(insert_list, table_name)
                    if result:
                        message = f"{result} records inserted into {table_name} table"
                        insert_result[f'{table_name}_duplicate_count'] = duplicate_count
                        insert_result[f'{table_name}_unique_count'] = unique_count
                    else:
                        message = f"Records are not inserted into {table_name} table"
                else:
                    message = f"No records found to insert into {table_name} table"
                insert_result[f'{table_name}_message'] = message

                table_recent, table_oct, additional_email_list = WoAudit.generate_tables(results)
                html_content = self.get_html_data(table_recent, table_oct)
            else:
                message = "No results found to send email"
        except Exception as e:
            message = f"Exception occurred in get_html_content: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}"
            logger.exception(message)
        logger.debug(message)

        try:

            users = []

            for result in results:

            plt.xticks(index + bar_width / 2, users, rotation=30, ha='right', fontsize=10)

            NoProcessAudit.autolabel(rects1, ax)

def submitted_preq_wf_email(self):
        try:
            pendingList_d = {}
            pendingList_l = []
            query = """SELECT 
                        group_concat(poworkflow.workflow_number) workflow_list, _alias_dwl.workflow_emails, bsw.stakeholder_wf_email
                        FROM
                                cifa.preq_details pd 
                            LEFT JOIN
                                cifa.po_workflow poworkflow ON pd.preq_number = poworkflow.preq_number
                            LEFT JOIN 
                                cifa.workflow_plan o ON o.workflow_id = poworkflow.workflow_number
                            LEFT JOIN
                                workflow.workflow w ON w.id = poworkflow.workflow_number
                            LEFT JOIN
                                workflow.entity e ON e.id = w.requestor_entity
                            LEFT JOIN
                            bom_database.preq_approval_plan pap ON pap.preq_number = poworkflow.preq_number
                            LEFT JOIN 
                            cifa.trigger_email t ON t.preq_number=pd.preq_number and t.type='incomplete_workflow'
                            LEFT JOIN
                            (SELECT 
                                dwl.workflow_id,
                                    GROUP_CONCAT(u.user_email) AS workflow_emails
                            FROM
                                bom_database.de_proc_workflow_log dwl
                            JOIN bom_database.users u ON u.user_id = dwl.user_id
                            GROUP BY dwl.workflow_id) AS _alias_dwl ON _alias_dwl.workflow_id = poworkflow.workflow_number
                                LEFT JOIN
                            (SELECT 
                                GROUP_CONCAT(workflow_email) AS stakeholder_wf_email,
                                    workflow_id
                            FROM
                                cifa.workflow_stakeholder) AS bsw ON bsw.workflow_id = poworkflow.workflow_number
                        WHERE
                            pd.status = 'INCOMPLETE'
                                AND pd.delete_flag = 0
                                AND w.active = 1
                                AND pap.preq_number IS NULL
                                and o.workflow_id is not NULL
                                and t.type is NULL 
                        GROUP BY pd.preq_number, poworkflow.workflow_number"""

            rows = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")
            for row in rows:
                pendingList_d = {'workflow_emails': row['workflow_emails'],
                                 'stakeholder_wf_email': row['stakeholder_wf_email']}
                pendingList_l.append(pendingList_d)
            return pendingList_l
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

def generate_line_historical(self):
        line_historical_path = f'/app/{self.line_historical}.png'
        try:
            query = """
                SELECT 
                    date_stamp, SUM(total_issues) AS total_issues
                FROM
                    matrix.wo_audit_history
                GROUP BY date_stamp
                ORDER BY date_stamp ASC
                """
            results = self.iom_utils.get_pagination_result(query)
            if results:
                data = {'dates': [], 'issues': []}

                for result in results:
                    data['dates'].append(result['date_stamp'])
                    data['issues'].append(result['total_issues'])

                font = {'size': 10}
                plt.rc('font', **font)

                fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6), dpi=80, facecolor='w', edgecolor='k')
                plt.title('Historical Deviations')
                plt.xlabel('Date')
                plt.ylabel('CRAN WOs')

                date_format = DateFormatter('%b-%d')
                ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(date_format)

                ax.set_xlim(data['dates'][0], data['dates'][-1])
                ax.set_ylim(min(data['issues']), max(data['issues']) + 10)

                plt.plot(data['dates'], data['issues'], linewidth=1.0)
                plt.grid()

                fig.autofmt_xdate()
                plt.legend(['Deviating WO Count'], loc='upper left', fontsize='small')

                plt.savefig(line_historical_path, bbox_inches='tight')
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in generate_line_historical: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return line_historical_path

def generate_line_engineer(self):
        line_engineer_path = f'/app/{self.line_engineer}.png'
        try:
            data = {'dates': [], 'engineer_list': {}}
            query = """
                SELECT 
                    engineer
                FROM
                    matrix.wo_audit_history
                WHERE
                    total_issues > 20
                GROUP BY engineer
                """
            results = self.iom_utils.get_pagination_result(query)
            if results:
                engineer_queries = []
                for result in results:
                    engineer = result['engineer']
                    data['engineer_list'][engineer] = []
                    engineer_queries.append(f"SUM(IF(engineer='{engineer}', total_issues, 0)) AS issues_{engineer}")

                engineer_query_part = ', '.join(engineer_queries)

                query = f"""
                    SELECT date_stamp, {engineer_query_part}
                    FROM matrix.wo_audit_history 
                    GROUP BY date_stamp ORDER BY date_stamp ASC
                    """
                results = self.iom_utils.get_pagination_result(query)

                if results:
                    for result in results:
                        data['dates'].append(result['date_stamp'])
                        for engineer in data['engineer_list']:
                            data['engineer_list'][engineer].append(int(result[f"issues_{engineer}"]))
                    plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 10

                    fig, ax = plt.subplots(num=None, figsize=(11, 6), dpi=80, facecolor='w', edgecolor='k')
                    ax.set_title('Historical Deviations - per Deployment Engineer (Top 5)')
                    ax.set_xlabel('Date')
                    ax.set_ylabel('CRAN WOs')

                    date_fmt = DateFormatter('%b-%d')
                    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(date_fmt)
                    ax.set_xlim(data['dates'][0], data['dates'][-1])

                    eng_list = data['engineer_list']
                    legend_list = []

                    for eng in eng_list:
                        ax.plot(data['dates'], eng_list[eng], linewidth=1.0)
                        legend_list.append(eng)

                    ax.grid()
                    fig.autofmt_xdate()
                    ax.legend(legend_list, loc='upper left', fontsize='small')
                    plt.savefig(line_engineer_path, bbox_inches='tight')
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in generate_line_engineer: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return line_engineer_path

def violation(self):
        try:

            pd.preq_number,

            pd.creation_date,
            pd.justification,

            IF(GROUP_CONCAT( distinct po.bom_number) or GROUP_CONCAT( distinct pow.workflow_number), '', 'Missing internal_req_num') as violation,
            pap.preq_number as neteng_phase2_done,

            GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT po.bom_number) AS bom_list,

            (SELECT 
                    user_email
                FROM
                    bom_database.users
                WHERE
                    user_id = iq.de_ack_user limit 1) AS ack_user_email,
            (SELECT 
                    user_email
                FROM
                    bom_database.users
                WHERE
                    user_id = iq.user_submission_user) AS submitted_user,
            (SELECT 
                    user_email
                FROM
                    bom_database.users
                WHERE
                    user_id = iq.submission_manager) AS manager,
            (SELECT 
                    user_email
                FROM
                    bom_database.users
                WHERE
                    user_id = iq.de_ack_user) AS de_ack_user,
            (SELECT 
                    user_email
                FROM
                    bom_database.users
                WHERE
                    user_id = iq.soft_lock_user) AS soft_lock_user,
            (SELECT 
                    user_email
                FROM
                    bom_database.users
                WHERE
                    user_id = iq.de_lock_user) AS de_lock_user,
            (SELECT 
                    user_email
                FROM
                    bom_database.users
                WHERE
                    user_id IN (iq.total_hw_po_user , iq.partial_hw_po_user) limit 1) AS phase1_approver_email,
            (SELECT 
                    user_email
                FROM
                    bom_database.users
                WHERE
                    user_id = iq.finance_approval_user) AS finance_approval_user,
            (SELECT 
                    user_email
                FROM
                    bom_database.users
                WHERE
                    user_id = iq.finance_data_change_user) AS finance_date_change_user,
            bsh.bom_email AS bom_stake_holder,
            _alias_dwl.workflow_emails,
            bsw.stakeholder_wf_email
        FROM
            bom_database.preq_approval_plan pap
                JOIN
            cifa.preq_details pd ON pd.preq_number = pap.preq_number
                LEFT JOIN
            cifa.po_workflow pow ON pow.preq_number = pd.preq_number
                LEFT JOIN
            cifa.po_bom po ON po.preq_number = pd.preq_number
                LEFT JOIN
            cifa.workflow_plan w_plan ON w_plan.workflow_id = pow.workflow_number
                LEFT JOIN
            (SELECT 
                dwl.workflow_id,
                    GROUP_CONCAT(u.user_email) AS workflow_emails
            FROM
                bom_database.de_proc_workflow_log dwl
            JOIN bom_database.users u ON u.user_id = dwl.user_id
            GROUP BY dwl.workflow_id) AS _alias_dwl ON _alias_dwl.workflow_id = w_plan.workflow_id
                LEFT JOIN
            (SELECT 
                GROUP_CONCAT(workflow_email) AS stakeholder_wf_email,
                    workflow_id
            FROM
                cifa.workflow_stakeholder) AS bsw ON bsw.workflow_id = w_plan.workflow_id
                LEFT JOIN
            cifa.oracle_bom_plan o_plan ON o_plan.bom_id = po.bom_number
                LEFT JOIN
            (SELECT

                    bss.total_hw_po_user,

                    CASE

def bom_de_ack_queue2(self):
        try:
            pendingList = dict()
            pendingList_d = {}
            pendingList_l = []
            query = """SELECT b.bom_id, b.bom_name, b.bom_time,  t.team_name, bs.bom_status_name, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as now_info,
                        bss.soft_lock_time as last_action,
                        SUM(boms_parts_count) as parts_count,
                        (SELECT user_fullname from bom_database.users where user_id = bss.de_ack_user) as ack_user,
                        CASE
                        WHEN
                        bss.comm_submission_user IS NOT NULL
                        AND bss.cit_submission_user IS NOT NULL
                        THEN
                        bss.cit_submission_user
                        WHEN bss.cit_submission_user IS NOT NULL THEN bss.cit_submission_user
                        WHEN bss.comm_submission_user IS NOT NULL THEN bss.comm_submission_user
                        ELSE bss.manager_submission_user
                        END AS manager_submission_user,
                        (SELECT user_fullname from bom_database.users where user_id = manager_submission_user) as manager,
                        (SELECT user_fullname from bom_database.users where user_id = b.bom_author) as bom_creator,
                        CASE
                        WHEN
                        bss.comm_submission_time IS NOT NULL
                        AND bss.cit_submission_time IS NOT NULL
                        THEN
                        bss.cit_submission_time
                        WHEN bss.cit_submission_time IS NOT NULL THEN bss.cit_submission_time
                        WHEN bss.comm_submission_time IS NOT NULL THEN bss.comm_submission_time
                        ELSE bss.manager_submission_time
                        END AS manager_submission_time,
                        bss.soft_lock_time,
                        bss.de_ack_time,
                        (SELECT user_fullname from bom_database.users where user_id = bss.soft_lock_user) as soft_lock_user,
                        (SELECT user_email from bom_database.users where user_id = bss.de_ack_user) as ack_user_email, group_concat( distinct pobom.po_number) as po_number,
                        if(bss.partial_wo_submission_time, bss.partial_wo_submission_time, CURRENT_TIME) as partial_wo_submission_time
                        from bom_database.boms b 
                        LEFT JOIN cifa.po_bom pobom ON pobom.bom_number=b.bom_id
                        JOIN bom_database.boms_parts bp ON bp.boms_parts_bom = b.bom_id
                        LEFT JOIN bom_database.boms_status bs ON bs.bom_status_id = b.bom_status
                        LEFT JOIN bom_database.bom_status_stamp bss ON bss.bom_id = b.bom_id
                        JOIN bom_database.regions r ON r.region_id = b.bom_region
                        JOIN bom_database.divisions d ON d.division_id = r.region_division
                        JOIN bom_database.teams t ON t.team_id = d.division_team 
                        where b.bom_status in (10)  and b.bom_archived=0 and b.bom_id in (select distinct associate_id as bom_id from bom_database.wo_creation where wo_status in ('draft', 'Draft'))
                        group by b.bom_id
                        HAVING parts_count > 0;
            """

def insert_wo_line(self):
        insert_result = {}
        try:

            file_found, count = IomUtils.count_rows_in_csv(self.file_path)
            insert_result['count_from_csv'] = count

            if file_found and count:

                with open(self.file_path, 'r') as csv_file:
                    csv_reader = csv.reader(csv_file)
                    headers = [
                        "woNumber",
                        "manufacturerId",
                        "model",
                        "name",
                        "po",
                        "projectNumberPurchased",
                        "qtyOnWo",
                        "serialNumber",
                        "assetId",
                        "lineId"
                    ]

                    project_dict = self.iom_utils.get_project()
                    insert_list = []
                    invalid_wo_numbers = []
                    missing_model_ids = []

                    for row in csv_reader:
                        result_dict = dict(zip(headers, row))
                        try:
                            wo_number = result_dict.get('woNumber').split('-') if result_dict.get('woNumber') else None
                            work_order_number = IomUtils.get_numeric_value(wo_number[1]) if wo_number and len(wo_number) > 1 else None
                            work_order_prefix = wo_number[0] if wo_number and 1 < len(wo_number[0]) < 4 else None

                            if work_order_number and work_order_prefix:
                                line_id = IomUtils.get_numeric_value(result_dict.get('lineId'), value_range="int")

                                manufacturer_id = IomUtils.get_numeric_value(result_dict.get('manufacturerId'), value_range="bigint")
                                manufacturer_id = manufacturer_id if manufacturer_id else 0

                                po = result_dict.get('po').strip() if result_dict.get('po') else None
                                po = po[:po.index(' ')] if po and len(po) >= 100 else po
                                po = sub(r'[^\x20-\x7E]', '', po) if po else None

                                model = result_dict.get('model')
                                model_id = self.iom_utils.get_model_id(model)
                                if not model_id and model and len(model.strip()) > 0:
                                    missing_model_ids.append({po: model})

                                serial_number = result_dict.get('serialNumber')
                                asset_id = result_dict.get('assetId')
                                if serial_number and asset_id and serial_number != asset_id and serial_number[0].lower() == 's':
                                    serial_number = asset_id
                                serial_number = sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9\-/\\|\.]+", "", serial_number)[:255] if serial_number else None

                                project_number_purchased = result_dict.get('projectNumberPurchased')
                                project_id = project_dict.get(project_number_purchased.strip().lower()) if project_number_purchased else None

                                qty_on_wo = IomUtils.get_numeric_value(result_dict.get('qtyOnWo'), value_range="mediumint")

                                insert_list.append({
                                    "lineId": line_id,
                                    "woNumber": work_order_number,
                                    "woPrefix": work_order_prefix,
                                    "manufacturerId": manufacturer_id,
                                    "model": model_id,
                                    "serialNumber": serial_number,
                                    "po": po,
                                    "projectId": project_id,
                                    "qtyOnWo": qty_on_wo
                                })
                            else:
                                invalid_wo_numbers.append(result_dict.get('woNumber'))
                        except Exception as e:
                            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in result_dict: {result_dict}, {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
                        count = count - 1
                        if count < 0:
                            logger.debug(f"File is still uploading, will retry after 5 mins.")
                            sleep(300)
                            return self.insert_wo_line()
                    if insert_list:
                        result, duplicate_count, unique_count = self.iom_utils.insert_data(insert_list, self.table_name, truncate=True)
                        if result:
                            logger.debug(f"{result} records inserted into {self.table_name} table")
                        insert_result['duplicate_count'] = duplicate_count
                        insert_result['unique_count'] = unique_count
                    else:
                        result = 0
                    insert_result['total_records_inserted'] = result
                    insert_result['invalid_wo_numbers'] = len(invalid_wo_numbers)
                    insert_result['missing_model_ids'] = len(missing_model_ids)
            else:
                logger.debug(f"File not found (path: {self.file_path}) or no data (count: {count}) in the file")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in insert_wo_line: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return insert_result

def report_store(self):
        try:
            util.start()

            start_time = datetime.now()

            self.execute_scripts()
            email_data = self.get_stats()
            status, message = IomUtils.send_email_from_api(email_data)
            logger.debug(f"Email status: {status}, message: {message}, email_data: {email_data}")

            end_time = datetime.now()
            time_difference = end_time - start_time

            days = time_difference.days
            seconds = time_difference.seconds
            hours, remainder = divmod(seconds, 3600)
            minutes, seconds = divmod(remainder, 60)

            logger.debug(f"Start time: {start_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p')}")
            logger.debug(f"End time: {end_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p')}")
            logger.debug(f"Total script run time: {days} days {hours} hours {minutes} minutes {seconds} seconds")

        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in report_store: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

def get_stats(self, retry=0):
        email_data = {}
        try:
            tables = {
                'projects',
                'itemmaster',
                'cifa2',
                'rollup',
                'tracking',
                'requestor',
                'pop',
                'packingList',
                'assetComp',
                'updateDuplicates',
                'fmAssets',
                'po',
                'po2',
                'po3',
                'wo_bom',
                'wo_dns',
                'wo_log',
                'wo',
                'woLine',
                'api_tasks',
                'api_contacts',
                'api_dns',
                'api_expenditures',
                'api_addresses'
            }
            query = f"SELECT log_id, `table`, runTime, result FROM filemaker.log WHERE DATE(createTime) = CURDATE() AND `table` in {tuple(tables)};"
            results = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")

            result_dict = {}
            tables_from_db = set()
            total_run_time = timedelta()
            for result in results:
                tables_from_db.add(result.get('table'))
                parts = result.get('runTime').split()
                days = int(parts[0])
                hours = int(parts[2])
                minutes = int(parts[4])
                seconds = int(parts[6])
                row_time = timedelta(days=days, hours=hours, minutes=minutes, seconds=seconds)
                total_run_time += row_time

                success = False
                result_json = loads(result['result'])
                if result['table'] == 'updateDuplicates':
                    if result_json.get('updated_count'):
                        success = True
                else:
                    if result_json.get('unique_count') and result_json.get('total_records_inserted') and result_json.get('unique_count') == result_json.get('total_records_inserted'):
                        success = True
                    else:
                        unique_count = None
                        total_records_inserted = None
                        message = ''
                        for key, value in result_json.items():
                            if str(key).endswith('unique_count'):
                                unique_count = result_json.get(key)
                            elif str(key).endswith('total_records_inserted'):
                                total_records_inserted = result_json.get(key)
                            elif str(key).endswith('message'):
                                message = result_json.get(key)
                        if unique_count and total_records_inserted and unique_count == total_records_inserted:
                            success = True
                        elif message and message.startswith('No records found to insert'):
                            success = True
                if success:
                    result_dict.setdefault('success', []).append(result['log_id'])
                else:
                    result_dict.setdefault('fail', []).append(result['log_id'])

            if result_dict.get('success'):
                success_ids = ','.join(map(str, result_dict.get('success')))
                query = f"UPDATE filemaker.log SET `status` = '1' WHERE log_id IN ({success_ids});"
                self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "UPDATE")
            if result_dict.get('fail'):
                fail_ids = ','.join(map(str, result_dict.get('fail')))
                query = f"DELETE FROM filemaker.log WHERE log_id IN ({fail_ids});"
                self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "DELETE")

            if (result_dict.get('fail') or tables != tables_from_db) and retry == 0:
                self.execute_scripts(retry=1)
                return self.get_stats(retry=1)

            if tables == tables_from_db and result_dict.get('fail') is None:
                days = total_run_time.days
                seconds = total_run_time.seconds
                hours, remainder = divmod(seconds, 3600)
                minutes, seconds = divmod(remainder, 60)

                email_data['Subject'] = f"[Filemaker] script execution is successful: {datetime.now().date()}"
                email_data['Message'] = 'Successfully executed all the scripts'
                email_data['Run Time'] = f"{days} days {hours} hours {minutes} minutes {seconds} seconds"
            else:
                email_data['Subject'] = f"[Filemaker] script execution is not successful: {datetime.now().date()}"
                email_data['Message'] = 'All the scripts are not executed'
                email_data['Missing Scripts'] = tables - tables_from_db

        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in get_stats: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return email_data

def update_duplicates(self, only_recent=0):
        update_result = {}
        serial_numbers = []
        start_time = datetime.now()
        try:
            # MASTER DATA
            master_query = f"""
                SELECT
                    f.recordId,
                    CASE
                        WHEN r.rack IS NULL OR r.rack LIKE 'MIA%%' THEN 'MIA'
                        ELSE 'NOT MIA'
                    END AS racks,
                    CASE
                        WHEN a.assetID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ASSET ID'
                        ELSE 'NO ASSET ID'
                    END AS asset_status
                FROM
                    {self.iom_utils.schema_name}.fmAssets f
                        LEFT JOIN
                    {self.iom_utils.schema_name}.rack r ON f.rack = r.rackId
                        LEFT JOIN
                    {self.iom_utils.schema_name}.assetComp a ON f.assetId = a.assetID """
            if only_recent:
                master_query += "WHERE (DATE(f.updatedDateTime) = CURDATE() OR DATE(f.dateRun) = CURDATE()) "
            master_list = self.iom_utils.get_pagination_result(master_query)
            master_ids = [master_dict.get('asset_status') for master_dict in master_list]
            logger.debug(f"Total records in {self.table_name}: {len(master_ids)}")
            update_result['master_result'] = len(master_ids)

            # 'NO ASSET ID': DELETE = 1
            # 'ASSET ID': DELETE = NULL
            # 'NOT MIA': daysInInv = DIFF
            # 'MIA': daysInInv = NULL

            delete_1 = [master_dict['recordId'] for master_dict in master_list if master_dict.get('asset_status') == 'NO ASSET ID']
            delete_null = [master_dict['recordId'] for master_dict in master_list if master_dict.get('asset_status') == 'ASSET ID']
            days_diff = [master_dict['recordId'] for master_dict in master_list if master_dict.get('racks') == 'NOT MIA']
            days_null = [master_dict['recordId'] for master_dict in master_list if master_dict.get('racks') == 'MIA']

            delete_1_days_diff = list(set(delete_1) & set(days_diff))
            delete_1_days_null = list(set(delete_1) & set(days_null))
            delete_null_days_diff = list(set(delete_null) & set(days_diff))
            delete_null_days_null = list(set(delete_null) & set(days_null))

            logger.debug(f"delete_1_days_diff: {len(delete_1_days_diff)}")
            logger.debug(f"delete_1_days_null: {len(delete_1_days_null)}")
            logger.debug(f"delete_null_days_diff: {len(delete_null_days_diff)}")
            logger.debug(f"delete_null_days_null: {len(delete_null_days_null)}")

            message = "UPDATE daysInInv to NULL & delete to NULL"
            query = f"UPDATE {self.table_name} SET `daysInInv` = NULL, `delete` = NULL WHERE `recordId` IN (%s);"
            update_result[message] = self.iom_utils.update_query_pagination(query, delete_null_days_null, message)

            message = "UPDATE daysInInv to NULL & delete to 1"
            query = f"UPDATE {self.table_name} SET `daysInInv` = NULL, `delete` = 1 WHERE `recordId` IN (%s);"
            update_result[message] = self.iom_utils.update_query_pagination(query, delete_1_days_null, message)

            message = "UPDATE daysInInv to DATEDIFF & delete to NULL"
            query = f"UPDATE {self.table_name} SET `daysInInv` = DATEDIFF(NOW(), `dateLastReceived`), `delete` = NULL WHERE `recordId` IN (%s);"
            update_result[message] = self.iom_utils.update_query_pagination(query, delete_null_days_diff, message)

            message = "UPDATE daysInInv to DATEDIFF & delete to 1"
            query = f"UPDATE {self.table_name} SET `daysInInv` = DATEDIFF(NOW(), `dateLastReceived`), `delete` = 1 WHERE `recordId` IN (%s);"
            update_result[message] = self.iom_utils.update_query_pagination(query, delete_1_days_diff, message)

            main_query = f"""
                SELECT
                    _temp.serialNumber,
                    _temp.dateLastReceived,
                    MAX(IF(fm.dateLastReceived = _temp.dateLastReceived,
                        (SELECT
                                assetId
                            FROM
                                {self.iom_utils.schema_name}.fmAssets
                            WHERE
                                serialNumber = _temp.serialNumber
                                    AND dateLastReceived = _temp.dateLastReceived
                            ORDER BY dateLastReceived DESC
                            LIMIT 1),
                        0)) AS assetId,
                    MAX(IF(fm.dateLastReceived = _temp.dateLastReceived,
                        (SELECT
                                recordId
                            FROM
                                {self.iom_utils.schema_name}.fmAssets
                            WHERE
                                serialNumber = _temp.serialNumber
                                    AND dateLastReceived = _temp.dateLastReceived
                            ORDER BY dateLastReceived DESC
                            LIMIT 1),
                        0)) AS recordId,
                    _temp.dateCreated,
                    MAX(IF(fm.dateCreated = _temp.dateCreated,
                        (SELECT
                                fm.projectIdPurchased
                            FROM
                                {self.iom_utils.schema_name}.fmAssets
                            WHERE
                                serialNumber = _temp.serialNumber
                                    AND dateCreated = _temp.dateCreated
                            ORDER BY dateCreated ASC
                            LIMIT 1),
                        0)) AS projectIdPurchased,
                    MAX(IF(fm.dateCreated = _temp.dateCreated,
                        (SELECT
                                fm.entity
                            FROM
                                {self.iom_utils.schema_name}.fmAssets
                            WHERE
                                serialNumber = _temp.serialNumber
                                    AND dateCreated = _temp.dateCreated
                            ORDER BY dateCreated ASC
                            LIMIT 1),

                    MAX(IF(fm.dateCreated = _temp.dateCreated,

                                serialNumber = _temp.serialNumber

                SET

def refresh_fm_model_rollup_detail(self, insert_result):
        try:
            query = """
                 SELECT 
                    m2.modelId AS model_id,
                    c2.cifaNumber AS cifa,
                    fa.poOrg AS po_org,
                    IFNULL(fa.rollupId, 0) AS rollup_id,
                    SUM(IF(CHAR_LENGTH(fa.serialNumber) >= 5,
                        1,
                        IFNULL(fa.qtyOnHand, 0) + IFNULL(fa.qtyShipped, 0))) AS total_received,
                    SUM(IF(s1.statusName = 'Open Stock'
                            AND fa.rack IS NOT NULL,
                        IF(CHAR_LENGTH(fa.serialNumber) >= 5,
                            1,
                            IFNULL(fa.qtyOnHand, 1)),
                        0)) AS total_openstock,
                    SUM(IF(s1.statusName = 'Open Stock',
                        fa.qtyOnHand,
                        0)) AS total_open_stock_revised,
                    SUM(IF((cifaType = 'Capital' OR fieldReturn = 1),
                        fa.qtyOnHand,
                        0)) AS total_wh_capital_revised,
                    SUM(IF(s1.statusName IN ('Active' , 'Open Stock')
                            AND ((cifaType != 'Capital'
                            OR fieldReturn <> 1)
                            OR (cifaType IS NULL
                            AND IFNULL(fieldReturn, 0) = 0)),
                        fa.qtyOnHand,
                        0)) AS total_wh_inventory_revised,
                    SUM(IF(CHAR_LENGTH(fa.serialNumber) >= 5,
                        IF(fa.rack IS NULL, 1, 0),
                        IFNULL(fa.qtyShipped, 0))) AS total_shipped,
                    SUM(IF(CHAR_LENGTH(fa.serialNumber) >= 5
                            AND fa.rack IS NOT NULL
                            AND cifaType = 'Capital',
                        1,
                        0)) AS total_wh_capital,
                    (SUM(IF(CHAR_LENGTH(fa.serialNumber) >= 5,
                        1,
                        IFNULL(fa.qtyOnHand, 0) + IFNULL(fa.qtyShipped, 0))) - SUM(IF(CHAR_LENGTH(fa.serialNumber) >= 5,
                        IF(fa.rack IS NULL, 1, 0),
                        IFNULL(fa.qtyShipped, 0))) - SUM(IF(CHAR_LENGTH(fa.serialNumber) >= 5
                            AND fa.rack IS NOT NULL
                            AND cifaType = 'Capital',
                        1,
                        0))) AS total_wh_inventory,
                    SUM(IF(CHAR_LENGTH(fa.serialNumber) >= 5
                            AND fa.rack IS NOT NULL
                            AND fa.fieldReturn = 1
                            AND s1.statusName = 'Open Stock',
                        1,
                        0)) AS total_field_return_open_inv,
                    SUM(IF(CHAR_LENGTH(fa.serialNumber) >= 5
                            AND fa.rack IS NOT NULL
                            AND fa.fieldReturn = 1
                            AND s1.statusName != 'Open Stock'
                            AND cifaType = 'Capital',
                        1,
                        0)) AS total_field_return_active,
                    IFNULL(man2.manufacturerId, 0) AS manufacturer_id,
                    NOW() AS date_run
                FROM
                    filemaker.fmAssets fa
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker.cifa c1 ON c1.cifaId = fa.cifa
                        AND c1.cifaNumber REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker2.cifa c2 ON c2.cifaNumber = c1.cifaNumber
                        AND c2.cifaNumber REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker.`status` s1 ON s1.statusId = fa.assetStatus
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker2.`status` s2 ON s2.statusName = s1.statusName
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker.model m1 ON m1.modelId = fa.modelId
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker2.model m2 ON m2.modelName = m1.modelName
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker.manufacturer man1 ON man1.manufacturerId = fa.manufacturerId
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker2.manufacturer man2 ON man2.manufacturerName = man1.manufacturerName
                WHERE
                    fa.`delete` IS NULL
                GROUP BY fa.poOrg , fa.modelId , fa.manufacturerId , fa.rollupId
            """
            self.iom_utils.run_query("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bom_database.fm_model_rollup_detail_temp LIKE bom_database.fm_model_rollup_detail")
            insert_result = self.iom_utils.select_and_insert_data("bom_database.fm_model_rollup_detail_temp", insert_result=insert_result, query=query, truncate=True)
            status = insert_result['bom_database.fm_model_rollup_detail_temp_total_records_inserted']
            if status:
                insert_result['drop bom_database.fm_model_rollup_detail'] = self.iom_utils.run_query("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bom_database.fm_model_rollup_detail")
                query = "RENAME TABLE bom_database.fm_model_rollup_detail_temp TO bom_database.fm_model_rollup_detail"
                insert_result['rename to bom_database.fm_model_rollup_detail'] = self.iom_utils.run_query(query)
            else:
                insert_result['refresh_fm_model_rollup_detail status'] = "New data is not inserted."
        except Exception as e:
            message = f"Exception occurred in refresh_fm_model_rollup_detail: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}"
            logger.exception(message)
            insert_result['refresh_fm_model_rollup_detail'] = message
        return insert_result

                                    "Coalesce_Oracle_Model": coalesce_oracle_model,

                                    "forecastDate": forecast_date,
                                    "unitPrice": unit_price,
                                    "rollupId": rollup_id,
                                    "projectId": project_id,
                                    "fieldReturn": field_return,
                                    "ad": ad,
                                    "WeightedAvgDateAssetCreated": w_a_d_a_c,
                                    "WeightedAvgDateAssetLastReceived": w_a_d_a_l_r,
                                    "DateVariance": date_variance,
                                    "name": name,
                                    "CIFACategory": cifa_category,
                                    "QuarterLastReceived": quarter_last_received,
                                    "assetValue": asset_value,
                                    "MonthsDepreciated": months_depreciated,
                                    "Valuation": valuation,
                                    "assetCount": asset_count,
                                    "poModelId": po_model_id,
                                    "AssetCountNotDamaged": asset_count_not_damaged
                                })
                            else:
                                invalid_pop.append(pop)
                        except Exception as e:
                            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in result_dict: {result_dict}, {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
                        count = count - 1
                        if count < 0:
                            logger.debug(f"File is still uploading, will retry after 5 mins.")
                            sleep(300)
                            return self.insert_pop()
                    if insert_list:
                        result, duplicate_count, unique_count = self.iom_utils.insert_data(insert_list, self.table_name, truncate=True)

class DefectiveCpak:
    def __init__(self):
        self.iom_utils = IomUtils()
        self.matrix_utils = IomUtils(db_name="matrix_db", schema_name='matrix')
        self.defective_cpak()

    def defective_cpak(self):
        try:
            start_time = datetime.now()
            util.start()
            insert_result = self.update_invalid_pointers()
            insert_result = self.update_status(insert_result)
            insert_result = self.update_replacement(insert_result)
            logger.debug(dumps(insert_result, indent=2))

            end_time = datetime.now()
            self.iom_utils.calculate_run_time(start_time, end_time, "defective_cpak", insert_result, "defective_cpak")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in defective_cpak: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

    def update_invalid_pointers(self):
        insert_result = {}
        try:
            query = """
                SELECT 
                    dc.serial_number
                FROM
                    matrix.defective_cpak dc
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker.fmAssets fa ON fa.recordId = dc.fm_recordId
                        AND fa.`delete` IS NULL
                WHERE
                    fa.recordId IS NULL
                """
            results = self.matrix_utils.get_pagination_result(query)
            serial_numbers = [result.get('serial_number') for result in results]
            serial_numbers.extend([f"S{result.get('serial_number')}" for result in results])

            if serial_numbers:
                serial_numbers = ','.join(map(lambda x: f"'{x}'", serial_numbers))
                query = f"""
                    SELECT 
                        recordId, fa.serialNumber
                    FROM
                        filemaker.fmAssets fa
                    WHERE
                        fa.serialNumber IN ({serial_numbers})
                            AND fa.`delete` IS NULL
                    """
                results = self.matrix_utils.get_pagination_result(query)
                values = [(result["recordId"], result["serialNumber"]) for result in results]

                if values:
                    query = "UPDATE matrix.defective_cpak SET fm_recordId = %s WHERE serial_number = %s"
                    message = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "UPDATE", values)
                else:
                    message = "1 - No data is found to update"
            else:
                message = "2 - No data is found to update"
        except Exception as e:
            message = f"Exception occurred in update_invalid_pointers: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}"
            logger.exception(message)
        insert_result["update_invalid_pointers"] = message
        return insert_result

    def update_status(self, insert_result):
        try:
            query = """
                UPDATE matrix.defective_cpak dc
                        JOIN
                    filemaker.fmAssets fa ON fa.recordId = dc.fm_recordId
                        LEFT JOIN
                    matrix.wo_fmAssets wfa ON wfa.fm_recordId = dc.fm_recordId
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker.packingList pl ON pl.packingListId = wfa.latest_packingList
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker.wo ON wo.woNumber = pl.woNumber
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker.projects p ON p.project_id = fa.projectIdDeployed
                        LEFT JOIN
                    bom_database.offnet_asset_plan ap ON ap.modelId = 7379
                        AND ap.plan_type = 'ARO'
                        AND ap.complete_flag = 0
                        AND ap.serial_number = dc.serial_number 
                SET 
                    dc.status = CASE
                        WHEN fa.rack IS NOT NULL THEN 'warehouse'
                        WHEN wfa.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'onNet'
                        WHEN
                            wo.title LIKE 'LABRMA%'
                                OR p.project_name = 'LabRMA'
                        THEN
                            'labRMA'
                        WHEN fa.vendorRma = 1 THEN 'vendorRMA'
                        WHEN wfa.status = 'RMA' THEN 'RMA'
                        WHEN fa.task IN ('Consignment' , 'Bid') THEN 'consign'
                        WHEN ap.plan_type = 'ARO' THEN 'planARO'
                        WHEN pl.woNumber > wfa.aro_number THEN 'shippedAgain'
                        ELSE 'shipped'
                    END,
                    dc.aro_number = IFNULL(wfa.aro_number, dc.aro_number),
                    dc.wo_number = pl.woNumber
                """
            message = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "UPDATE")
        except Exception as e:
            message = f"Exception occurred in update_status: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}"
            logger.exception(message)
        insert_result["update_status"] = message
        return insert_result

    def update_replacement(self, insert_result):
        try:
            query = """
                INSERT INTO matrix.defective_cpak_replacement (return_aro) 
                SELECT 
                    aro_number
                FROM
                    matrix.defective_cpak
                WHERE
                    aro_number IS NOT NULL
                        AND aro_number NOT IN (SELECT 
                            return_aro
                        FROM
                            matrix.defective_cpak_replacement)
                GROUP BY aro_number
                """
            insert_result["insert-1"] = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "INSERT", bulk_insert=True)

            query = """
                UPDATE matrix.defective_cpak_replacement dcp
                        JOIN
                    (SELECT 
                        dcp.id, COUNT(dc.id) AS cpak_count
                    FROM
                        matrix.defective_cpak_replacement dcp
                    JOIN matrix.defective_cpak dc ON dc.aro_number = dcp.return_aro
                    GROUP BY dcp.id) m ON m.id = dcp.id 
                SET 
                    dcp.aro_cpak = m.cpak_count
                """
            insert_result["update-1"] = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "UPDATE")

            query = """
                UPDATE matrix.defective_cpak_replacement dcp
                        JOIN
                    (SELECT 
                        dcp.id, COUNT(pl.modelId) AS cpak_count
                    FROM
                        matrix.defective_cpak_replacement dcp
                    JOIN filemaker.packingList pl ON pl.woNumber = dcp.replacement_wo
                    GROUP BY dcp.replacement_wo) m ON m.id = dcp.id 
                SET 
                    dcp.wo_cpak = cpak_count
                """

                SELECT

                FROM

                    filemaker2.woStep ws ON ws.stepId = w.stepId

                    filemaker2.wo_bom wb ON wb.wo_number = w.woNumber

                    bom_database.boms b ON wb.bom_number = b.bom_id
                WHERE
                    stepName IN ('Draft' , 'In Progress',
                        'Staging Lab',
                        'Not Started',
                        'Shipping')
                        AND woPrefix IN ('WO')
                        AND bom_id NOT IN (74682)
                        AND bom_author NOT IN (563 , 437)
                GROUP BY w.woNumber
                ORDER BY stepName ASC
            """
            results = self.iom_utils.get_pagination_result(query)
            if results:
                wo_numbers = [result['woNumber'] for result in results]
                final_result = IomUtils.start_thread(UpdateWorkOrders.update_wo_from_api, wo_numbers)

            end_time = datetime.now()
            self.iom_utils.calculate_run_time(start_time, end_time, table="update_work_orders", result=final_result, comment="update_work_orders")
        except Exception as e:

    def update_wo_from_api(wo_number):
        result = []
        status = False
        try:
            url = "https://iom.comcast.net/api/filemaker/on_demand"
            payload = dumps({
                "action": "get_required_wo",
                "wo_number": [wo_number],
            })
            headers = {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            }

            response = request("POST", url, headers=headers, data=payload)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                if response.json().get('parsed_api_work_orders_response', {}).get('status'):
                    status = True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in update_work_orders: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        result.append({"wo_number": wo_number, "status": status})
        return result

                                "from_library_api": from_library_api,
                                "asset_id": asset_id,

                            })

            result = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")

                    FROM
                        filemaker2.script_stamp_status

                    """
                result = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")

                    query = f"""
                        UPDATE filemaker2.script_stamp_status 
                        SET 
                            one_time_update = 0,
                            one_time_update_time = NOW()
                        WHERE
                            script_name = 'fm_assets_refresh'
                        """
                    insert_result['update_one_time_update_1'] = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "UPDATE")
                else:
                    insert_result['update_one_time_update_1'] = "No update"

                query = f"""

                        one_time_update,
                        IF(DATE(one_time_update_time) < CURDATE(),
                            1,

                    FROM
                        filemaker2.script_stamp_status
                    WHERE
                        script_name = 'fm_assets_refresh';

        insert_result = {}
        try:
            query = """
                SELECT 
                    woNumber, title
                FROM
                    filemaker.wo
                WHERE
                    woPrefix = 'WO' AND title LIKE '%bom%'
                """
            results = self.matrix_utils.get_pagination_result(query)

            query_result = []
            for result in results:
                wo_number = result.get('woNumber')
                title = self.iom_utils.get_converted_value(result.get('title'))
                bom_numbers = findall(r'bom[\s:_;#\-=]*(\d{4,5})(?:[^\d]{1}|$)', title, IGNORECASE)
                for bom_number in bom_numbers:
                    query_result.append({
                        "bom_number": bom_number,
                        "wo_number": wo_number
                    })

            insert_result = self.matrix_utils.select_and_insert_data(table_name, insert_result, query_result=query_result, truncate=True, table_prefix=1)

            query = """
                SELECT 
                    wo_number, bom_number
                FROM
                    filemaker.wo_bom
                        JOIN
                    bom_database.boms ON boms.bom_id = wo_bom.bom_number
                WHERE
                    bom_number > 999
                """
            insert_result = self.matrix_utils.select_and_insert_data(table_name, insert_result, query=query, table_prefix=2)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in insert_wo_bom_tmp: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return insert_result

    def insert_wo_bom(self, insert_result):

            query = """

                        LEFT JOIN
                    matrix.wo_bom_tmp wbt ON wbt.wo_number = wb.woNumber
                        AND wbt.bom_number = wb.bomNumber 
                WHERE
                    wbt.bom_number IS NULL
                """
            result = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "DELETE")
            insert_result["delete"] = result

            query = """
                INSERT INTO matrix.wo_bom (woNumber, bomNumber, dateCreated) 
                    SELECT 
                    wbt.wo_number, wbt.bom_number, CURDATE()
                FROM
                    matrix.wo_bom wb
                        RIGHT JOIN
                    matrix.wo_bom_tmp wbt ON wbt.wo_number = wb.woNumber
                        AND wbt.bom_number = wb.bomNumber
                WHERE
                    wb.id IS NULL
                """
            result = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "INSERT", bulk_insert=True)
            insert_result["insert"] = result
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in insert_wo_bom: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return insert_result

                    slot,
                    'Active' AS `status`
                FROM

            insert_result = self.matrix_utils.select_and_insert_data(table_name, insert_result, query=query, table_prefix=6)

    def update_wo_fm_assets(self, insert_result):

            select_query = """
                SELECT
                    w_fa.fm_recordId AS id
                FROM
                    matrix.wo_fmAssets w_fa
                        JOIN
                    filemaker.fmAssets fa ON fa.recordId = w_fa.fm_recordId
                        LEFT JOIN
                    matrix.wo_fmAssets_tmp s ON s.serial_number = fa.serialNumber
                WHERE
                    fa.rack IS NULL
                        AND s.serial_number IS NULL
                        AND w_fa.`status` != 'Inactive'
                """

            update_query = """
                UPDATE matrix.wo_fmAssets
                SET
                    `status` = 'Inactive'
                WHERE
                    fm_recordId IN (%s)
                """

            comment = "Update matrix.wo_fmAssets.status = Inactive"
            insert_result = self.matrix_utils.select_and_update(select_query, update_query, insert_result, comment)

            query = """
                INSERT INTO matrix.wo_fmAssets (fm_recordId, status, serial_rma, fqdn_id, slot, first_found)
                SELECT
                    fa.recordId,
                    s.`status`,
                    s.serial_rma,
                    s.fqdn_id,
                    s.slot,
                    IF(s.`status` = 'Active', CURDATE(), NULL) AS first_found
                FROM
                    filemaker.fmAssets fa
                    JOIN matrix.wo_fmAssets_tmp s ON s.serial_number_s = fa.serialNumber
                WHERE
                    fa.rack IS NULL
                ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                    status = IF(wo_fmAssets.status = 'RMA' AND s.`status` != 'Active', 'RMA', s.status),
                    serial_rma = s.serial_rma,
                    fqdn_id = s.fqdn_id,
                    slot = s.slot,
                    first_found = IF(first_found IS NULL AND s.`status` = 'Active', CURDATE(), first_found);
                """
            result = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "INSERT", bulk_insert=True)
            logger.debug(f"1_insert: {result}")
            insert_result["1_insert"] = True if result else False

            query = """
                INSERT INTO matrix.wo_fmAssets (fm_recordId, status, serial_rma, fqdn_id, slot, first_found)
                SELECT
                    fa.recordId,
                    s.`status`,
                    s.serial_rma,
                    s.fqdn_id,
                    s.slot,
                    IF(s.`status` = 'Active', CURDATE(), NULL) AS first_found
                FROM
                    filemaker.fmAssets fa
                    JOIN matrix.wo_fmAssets_tmp s ON s.serial_number = fa.serialNumber
                WHERE
                    fa.rack IS NULL
                ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                    status = IF(wo_fmAssets.status = 'RMA' AND s.`status` != 'Active', 'RMA', s.status),
                    serial_rma = s.serial_rma,
                    fqdn_id = s.fqdn_id,
                    slot = s.slot,
                    first_found = IF(first_found IS NULL AND s.`status` = 'Active', CURDATE(), first_found);
                """
            result = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "INSERT", bulk_insert=True)
            logger.debug(f"2_insert: {result}")
            insert_result["2_insert"] = True if result else False

            select_query = """
                SELECT
                    fm_recordId AS id
                FROM
                    matrix.wo_fmAssets
                WHERE
                    wo_fmAssets.`status` = 'Active'
                """

            update_query = """
                UPDATE matrix.wo_fmAssets
                SET
                    last_active = CURDATE()
                WHERE
                    fm_recordId IN (%s)
                """

            comment = "Update matrix.wo_fmAssets.last_active = CURDATE()"
            insert_result = self.matrix_utils.select_and_update(select_query, update_query, insert_result, comment)

            select_query = """
                SELECT
                    rma.fm_recordId AS id
                FROM
                    matrix.wo_fmAssets rma
                        JOIN
                    matrix.wo_fmAssets_tmp `active` ON `active`.`status` = 'Active'
                        AND `active`.serial_number = rma.serial_rma
                WHERE
                    rma.serial_rma IS NOT NULL
                        AND rma.`status` = 'RMA'
                """

            update_query = """
                UPDATE matrix.wo_fmAssets rma
                        JOIN
                    matrix.wo_fmAssets_tmp `active` ON `active`.`status` = 'Active'
                        AND `active`.serial_number = rma.serial_rma
                SET
                    rma.fqdn_id = `active`.fqdn_id,
                    rma.serial_rma = `active`.serial_rma,
                    rma.slot = `active`.slot,
                    last_active = CURDATE()
                WHERE
                    rma.serial_rma IS NOT NULL
                        AND rma.`status` = 'RMA'
                        AND rma.fm_recordId IN (%s)
                """
            comment = "Update matrix.wo_fmAssets with matrix.wo_fmAssets_tmp"
            insert_result = self.matrix_utils.select_and_update(select_query, update_query, insert_result, comment)

            query = """
                INSERT INTO matrix.wo_fmAssets (fm_recordId, latest_packingList)
                SELECT
                    recordId,
                    max_packingList
                FROM (
                    SELECT
                        recordId,
                        MAX(packingListId) AS max_packingList
                    FROM
                        filemaker.fmAssets fa
                        JOIN filemaker.packingList pl ON pl.assetId = fa.assetId
                    WHERE
                        pl.woPrefix = 'WO'
                    GROUP BY
                        fa.recordId
                ) AS main
                ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                    latest_packingList = max_packingList;
                """
            result = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "INSERT", bulk_insert=True)
            logger.debug(f"3_insert: {result}")
            insert_result["3_insert"] = True if result else False

            query = """
                INSERT INTO matrix.wo_fmAssets (fm_recordId, aro_number, status)
                SELECT
                    fa.recordId,
                    MAX(wl.woNumber),
                    'ARO'
                FROM
                    filemaker.woLine wl
                    JOIN filemaker.fmAssets fa ON fa.modelId = wl.model AND fa.serialNumber = wl.serialNumber
                WHERE
                    wl.woPrefix = 'ARO'
                    AND CHAR_LENGTH(wl.serialNumber) >= 5
                    AND fa.delete IS NULL
                    AND fa.rack IS NOT NULL
                    AND fa.fieldReturn = 1
                    AND fa.cifaType = 'CAPITAL'
                GROUP BY
                    fa.recordId
                ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                    aro_number = VALUES(aro_number),
                    status = VALUES(status);
                """
            result = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "INSERT", bulk_insert=True)
            logger.debug(f"4_insert: {result}")
            insert_result["4_insert"] = True if result else False

            query = """
                UPDATE matrix.wo_fmAssets wfa
                        JOIN
                    (SELECT
                        wfa.fm_recordId, sub_query.woNumber AS aro
                    FROM
                        matrix.wo_fmAssets wfa
                    JOIN (SELECT
                        wfa.fm_recordId, wl.woPrefix, MAX(wl.woNumber) AS woNumber
                    FROM
                        filemaker.fmAssets fa
                    JOIN matrix.wo_fmAssets wfa ON wfa.fm_recordId = fa.recordId
                    JOIN filemaker.woLine wl ON wl.model = fa.modelId
                        AND wl.serialNumber = fa.serialNumber
                        AND wl.po = fa.po
                    WHERE
                        CHAR_LENGTH(fa.serialNumber) >= 5
                            AND fa.dateLastReceived > '2015-01-01'
                            AND wfa.`status` != 'ACTIVE'
                            AND fa.fieldReturn = 1
                            AND fa.`delete` IS NULL
                    GROUP BY fa.recordId) sub_query ON sub_query.fm_recordId = wfa.fm_recordId
                        AND sub_query.woPrefix = 'ARO'
                        AND sub_query.woNumber != aro_number) m ON m.fm_recordId = wfa.fm_recordId
                SET
                    aro_number = aro
                """
            comment = "Update matrix.wo_fmAssets.aro_number with MAX(filemaker.woLine.woNumber)"
            result = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "UPDATE")
            insert_result[comment] = result

            query = """
                INSERT INTO matrix.wo_fmAssets (fm_recordId, status)
                SELECT
                    fa.recordId,
                    CASE
                        WHEN fa.rack IS NOT NULL AND fa.task IN ('BID', 'CONSIGNMENT') THEN 'Consign'
                        WHEN p.project_name = 'LABRMA' THEN 'RMA-Lab'
                        WHEN fa.vendorRma = 1 THEN 'RMA-Vendor'
                        ELSE ''
                    END AS asset_status
                FROM
                    filemaker.fmAssets fa
                    JOIN filemaker.projects p ON p.project_id = fa.projectId
                    LEFT JOIN matrix.wo_fmAssets wfa ON wfa.fm_recordId = fa.recordId AND wfa.status = 'ACTIVE'
                WHERE
                    wfa.status IS NULL
                HAVING
                    asset_status IS NOT NULL AND asset_status != ''
                ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                    status = VALUES(status);
                """
            result = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "INSERT", bulk_insert=True)
            logger.debug(f"5_insert: {result}")
            insert_result["5_insert"] = True if result else False

            query = """
                INSERT INTO matrix.wo_fmAssets (fm_recordId, aro_number, status)
                SELECT
                    fa.recordId,
                    MAX(el.aroNumber),
                    'ARO'
                FROM
                    bom_database.fm_aro_equipmentList el
                    JOIN filemaker.fmAssets fa ON fa.serialNumber = el.serialNumber AND CHAR_LENGTH(el.serialNumber) >= 5
                WHERE
                    fa.delete IS NULL
                    AND fa.rack IS NOT NULL
                    AND fa.fieldReturn = 1
                    AND fa.cifaType = 'CAPITAL'
                GROUP BY
                    fa.recordId
                ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                    aro_number = VALUES(aro_number),
                    status = VALUES(status);
                """
            result = self.matrix_utils.run_query(query, "INSERT", bulk_insert=True)
            logger.debug(f"6_insert: {result}")
            insert_result["6_insert"] = True if result else False
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in update_wo_fm_assets: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return insert_result
