class FmModelKpi:
    def __init__(self):
        self.iom_utils = IomUtils()
        self.model_kpi_table = "bom_database.model_kpi"
        self.offnet_serial_history_kpi_table = "bom_database.offnet_serial_history_kpi"
        self.offnet_serial_history_temp_table = "bom_database.offnet_serial_history_temp"
        self.offnet_models_history_table = "bom_database.offnet_models_history"
        self.offnet_divisions_history_table = "bom_database.offnet_divisions_history"
        self.offnet_manager_history_table = "bom_database.offnet_manager_history"
        self.offnet_de_history_table = "bom_database.offnet_de_history"
        self.onnet_recovery_history_table = "bom_database.onnet_recovery_history"
        self.start_date = None
        self.fm_model_kpi()

    def fm_model_kpi(self):
        try:
            status = self.iom_utils.check_log_record('woLine', True)
            if status:
                start_time = datetime.now()
                util.start()
                insert_result = self.insert_model_kpi()
                insert_result = self.update_deprecated(insert_result)
                insert_result = self.insert_offnet_serial_history(self.offnet_serial_history_kpi_table, insert_result, mongo_insert=True)
                insert_result = self.insert_offnet_serial_history(self.offnet_serial_history_temp_table, insert_result)
                insert_result = self.insert_offnet_models_history(self.offnet_models_history_table, insert_result)
                insert_result = self.insert_offnet_divisions_history(self.offnet_divisions_history_table, insert_result)
                insert_result = self.insert_offnet_manager_history(self.offnet_manager_history_table, insert_result)
                insert_result = self.insert_offnet_de_history(self.offnet_de_history_table, insert_result)
                insert_result = self.insert_onnet_recovery_history(self.onnet_recovery_history_table, insert_result)

                OffnetPreQuarterUsage(self.iom_utils, self.start_date)
                OffnetCumulative(self.iom_utils)

                logger.debug(dumps(insert_result, indent=2))

                end_time = datetime.now()
                self.iom_utils.calculate_run_time(start_time, end_time, "fm_model_kpi", insert_result, "fm_model_kpi")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in fm_model_kpi: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

    def insert_model_kpi(self):
        insert_result = {}
        try:
            insert_result = self.insert_and_delete_mongo_db_data(insert_result)

            value = self.iom_utils.get_config_value(key="fm_model_kpi")
            if value:
                exclude_project_id = ','.join(map(str, value.get('exclude_project_id')))
                include_project_id = ','.join(map(str, value.get('include_project_id')))
                include_requested_by = ','.join(map(str, value.get('include_requested_by')))
                self.start_date = value.get('start_date')

                query = f"""
                    SELECT 
                        pl.assetId,
                        cifaNumber,
                        fa.poNumberPermanent,
                        fa.projectId,
                        pl.qtyShipped,
                        pl.modelId,
                        modelName,
                        modelNickName,
                        w_fa.last_active AS onNet,
                        pl.pop,
                        pop.rollupId,
                        IFNULL(fa.serialNumber, pl.serialNumber) AS serialNumber,
                        fa.fieldReturn,
                        fa.rack,
                        IFNULL(pop.unitPrice, fa.assetValue / 100) AS assetValue,
                        fa.manufacturerId,
                        pl.woNumber,
                        bomNumber,
                        title AS wo_title,
                        dateShipped,
                        wo.dateCreated AS wo_dateCreated,
                        pl.dateFound AS dateOnnet,
                        w_fa.status,
                        w_fa.fqdn_id AS fqdnId,
                        w_fa.slot
                    FROM
                        filemaker.fmAssets fa
                            JOIN
                        filemaker.model m ON m.modelId = fa.modelId
                            LEFT JOIN
                        bom_database.fm_undiscoverable und ON und.fm_modelId = fa.modelId
                            AND und.discoverable = 0
                            LEFT JOIN
                        matrix.wo_fmAssets w_fa ON w_fa.fm_recordId = fa.recordId
                            LEFT JOIN
                        filemaker.packingList pl ON pl.packingListId = w_fa.latest_packingList
                            LEFT JOIN
                        filemaker.wo ON wo.woNumber = pl.woNumber
                            LEFT JOIN
                        filemaker.wo_bom AS wb ON wb.wo_number = wo.woNumber
                            LEFT JOIN
                        filemaker.cifa ON cifa.cifaId = fa.cifa
                            LEFT JOIN
                        matrix.wo_bom ON wo_bom.woNumber = wo.woNumber
                            LEFT JOIN
                        (SELECT 
                            pop, modelId, rollupId, MAX(unitPrice) AS unitPrice
                        FROM
                            filemaker.pop
                        GROUP BY pop , modelId) AS pop ON pop.pop = pl.pop
                            AND pop.modelId = fa.modelId
                    WHERE
                        ((wo.title NOT LIKE '%%rma%%'
                            AND wo.title NOT LIKE '%%transport%%'
                            AND wo.title NOT LIKE '%%transbom%%'
                            AND wo.title NOT LIKE '%%transedp%%'
                            AND wo.title NOT LIKE 'NAT%%'
                            AND wo.title NOT REGEXP '(^| )lab'
                            AND wo.title NOT REGEXP '(_|-| |^)ene'
                            AND wo.title NOT LIKE '%%ENTERPRISE%%'
                            AND wo.title NOT LIKE '%%-NAT%%')
                            OR wb.bom_number IS NOT NULL)
                            AND wo.woPrefix = 'WO'
                            AND IFNULL(pl.delete, 0) = 0
                            AND wo.requestedBy IN ({include_requested_by})
                            AND wo.dateCreated >= '{self.start_date}'
                            AND (fa.projectIdPurchased IS NULL
                            OR fa.projectIdPurchased NOT IN ({exclude_project_id}))
                            AND und.id IS NULL
                            AND fa.delete IS NULL
                            AND (fa.projectId IN ({include_project_id})
                            OR fa.projectIdPurchased IN ({include_project_id}))
                    GROUP BY pl.assetId
                    """
                model_kpi_data = self.iom_utils.get_pagination_result(query)

                if model_kpi_data:
                    db_date_time, server_date_time = self.iom_utils.get_db_and_server_time()
                    update_columns = {'timestamp': db_date_time}
                    result, duplicate_count, unique_count = self.iom_utils.insert_data(model_kpi_data, self.model_kpi_table, update_columns=update_columns)
                    if result:
                        logger.debug(f"{result} records inserted into {self.model_kpi_table} table")
                        query = f"DELETE FROM {self.model_kpi_table} WHERE `timestamp` != '{db_date_time}';"
                        delete_status = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "DELETE")
                        if delete_status:
                            delete_message = "Successfully deleted old data"
                        else:
                            delete_message = "Not deleted old data"
                        logger.debug(delete_message)
                        insert_result['delete_message'] = delete_message
                    insert_result['mk_duplicate_count'] = duplicate_count
                    insert_result['mk_unique_count'] = unique_count
                else:
                    message = f"No records found to insert into {self.model_kpi_table} table"
                    logger.debug(message)
                    result = 0
                    insert_result['mk_message'] = message
                insert_result['mk_total_records_inserted'] = result
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in insert_model_kpi: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return insert_result

    def update_deprecated(self, insert_result):
        try:
            query = f"""
                SELECT 
                    modelId
                FROM
                    bom_database.model_kpi
                WHERE
                    modelName IN (SELECT DISTINCT
                            (SUBSTRING_INDEX(part_number, '=', 1)) AS part_number
                        FROM
                            bom_database.parts
                        WHERE
                            part_deprecated = 1)
                GROUP BY modelId
                """
            results = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")
            if results:
                model_ids = [result.get('modelId') for result in results]
                query = f"UPDATE {self.model_kpi_table} SET deprecated = 1 WHERE modelId IN (%s)"
                status = self.iom_utils.update_query_pagination(query, model_ids, "1 - UPDATE deprecated = 1")
                if status:
                    message = "1 - Updated deprecated to 1"
                else:
                    message = "1 - Not updated deprecated to 1"
            else:
                message = "1 - No data found to update deprecated to 1"
            logger.debug(message)
            insert_result['UPDATE_deprecated_1_1'] = message

            query = f"""
                SELECT modelId FROM {self.model_kpi_table} WHERE modelName IN ('XENPAK-10GB-LR-DOM') GROUP BY modelId
                """
            results = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")
            if results:
                model_ids = [result.get('modelId') for result in results]
                query = f"UPDATE {self.model_kpi_table} SET deprecated = 1 WHERE modelId IN (%s)"
                status = self.iom_utils.update_query_pagination(query, model_ids, "2 - UPDATE deprecated = 1")
                if status:
                    message = "2 - Updated deprecated to 1"
                else:
                    message = "2 - Not updated deprecated to 1"
            else:
                message = "2 - No data found to update deprecated to 1"
            logger.debug(message)
            insert_result['UPDATE_deprecated_1_2'] = message
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in update_deprecated: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return insert_result

    def insert_offnet_serial_history(self, table_name, insert_result, mongo_insert=False):
        try:
            query = f"""
                SELECT 
                    k.serialNumber,
                    IFNULL(k.rack, 0) AS rack,
                    IFNULL(k.`status`, 0) AS `status`,
                    IFNULL(k.fieldReturn, 0) AS fieldReturn,
                    CURDATE() AS datestamp
                FROM
                    model_kpi k
                        JOIN
                    filemaker.fmAssets fa ON fa.assetId = k.assetId
                        LEFT JOIN
                    (SELECT 
                        t1.serialNumber,
                            t1.`status`,
                            t1.datestamp,
                            t1.rack,
                            t1.fieldReturn
                    FROM
                        {table_name} t1
                    INNER JOIN (SELECT 
                        MAX(datestamp) AS datestamp, serialNumber
                    FROM
                        {table_name}
                    GROUP BY serialNumber) AS C ON C.serialNumber = t1.serialNumber
                        AND C.datestamp = t1.datestamp
                    GROUP BY t1.serialNumber) osht ON osht.serialNumber = k.serialNumber
                WHERE
                    k.assetValue > 0
                        AND k.woNumber NOT IN (303679 , 304081, 307882, 307889, 315455)
                        AND k.wo_title NOT LIKE 'ENE%'
                        AND k.dateShipped < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK)
                        AND k.deprecated = 0
                        AND k.discoverable = 1
                        AND (IF(CHAR_LENGTH(k.serialNumber) > 4
                            AND k.qtyShipped = 1,
                        1,
                        0))
                        AND (IFNULL(k.`status`, 0) <> osht.`status`
                        OR IFNULL(k.rack, 0) <> osht.rack
                        OR IFNULL(k.fieldReturn, 0) <> osht.fieldReturn)
                        OR osht.serialNumber IS NULL
                """
            insert_result = self.iom_utils.select_and_insert_data(table_name, insert_result, ignore=True, query=query)

            if mongo_insert:
                insert_result = self.select_and_insert_mongo_db_data(insert_result, table_name)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in insert_offnet_serial_history: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return insert_result

    def insert_offnet_models_history(self, table_name, insert_result):
        try:
            query = f"""
                SELECT 
                    k.modelName AS model,
                    ROUND(SUM(IF(k.rack IS NULL
                                    AND (k.`status` = 'Inactive'
                                    OR k.`status` IS NULL),
                                k.assetValue,
                                0))) AS asset_value,
                    ROUND(SUM(IF(op.serial_history_sn IS NOT NULL
                                    AND ((op.`status` = 'Inactive'
                                    OR op.`status` IS NULL)
                                    OR (op.`status` = '0' AND op.rack = '0'))
                                    AND k.rack IS NULL
                                    AND (k.`status` = 'Inactive'
                                    OR k.`status` IS NULL)
                                    AND op.offnet_plan_serial_sn IS NULL
                                    AND op.serial_history_sn NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT
                                        serialNumber
                                    FROM
                                        offnet_serial_history_kpi
                                    WHERE
                                        `status` = 'Active'),
                                k.assetValue,
                                0)),
                            2) AS never_active,
                    ROUND(SUM(IF(((op.`status` = 'Inactive'
                                    OR op.`status` IS NULL)
                                    OR (op.`status` = '0' AND op.rack = '0')
                                    OR op.`status` = 'ACTIVE')
                                    AND k.rack IS NULL
                                    AND (k.`status` = 'Inactive'
                                    OR k.`status` IS NULL)
                                    AND op.offnet_plan_serial_sn IS NULL
                                    AND op.serial_history_sn IN (SELECT DISTINCT
                                        serialNumber
                                    FROM
                                        offnet_serial_history_kpi
                                    WHERE
                                        `status` = 'Active'),
                                k.assetValue,
                                0)),
                            2) AS active_inactive,
                    NOW() AS updated_time
                FROM
                    model_kpi k
                        JOIN
                    filemaker.wo ON wo.woNumber = k.woNumber
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker.woStep ON woStep.stepId = wo.stepId
                        JOIN
                    (SELECT 
                        osht.serialNumber AS serial_history_sn,
                            osht.`status`,
                            op.serial_number AS offnet_plan_serial_sn,
                            dateCreated,
                            userName,
                            title,
                            op.id,
                            woStep.stepId,
                            osht.rack,
                            op.complete_flag,
                            adName,
                            op.aro_number,
                            DATE_FORMAT(op.date_planned, '%m/%d/%Y') AS date_planned,
                            DATEDIFF(NOW(), op.date_created) AS since_lastupdate,
                            op.plan_type
                    FROM
                        offnet_serial_history_kpi osht
                    INNER JOIN (SELECT 
                        MAX(datestamp) AS datestamp, serialNumber
                    FROM
                        offnet_serial_history_kpi
                    GROUP BY serialNumber) AS C ON C.serialNumber = osht.serialNumber
                        AND C.datestamp = osht.datestamp
                    LEFT JOIN offnet_asset_plan op ON osht.serialNumber = op.serial_number
                    LEFT JOIN filemaker.wo wo ON wo.woNumber = op.aro_number
                    LEFT JOIN filemaker.requestor ON requestorId = wo.requestedBy
                    LEFT JOIN filemaker.woStep ON woStep.stepId = wo.stepId
                    GROUP BY osht.serialNumber) op ON op.serial_history_sn = k.serialNumber
                WHERE
                    k.deprecated = 0 AND k.discoverable = 1
                        AND (IF(CHAR_LENGTH(k.serialNumber) > 4
                            AND k.qtyShipped = 1,
                        1,
                        0))
                        AND k.wo_title NOT LIKE 'ENE%'
                        AND k.dateShipped < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK)
                        AND k.woNumber NOT IN (303679 , 304081, 307882, 307889, 315455)
                GROUP BY modelName
                HAVING asset_value > 0
                """

            insert_result = self.iom_utils.select_and_insert_data(table_name, insert_result, ignore=True, query=query)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in insert_offnet_models_history: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return insert_result

class RefreshBomServiced:
    def __init__(self):
        self.iom_utils = IomUtils()
        self.refresh_bom_services()

    def refresh_bom_services(self):
        try:
            start_time = datetime.now()
            util.start()
            insert_result = {}

            boms_dict = self.get_boms()
            wo_parts_list = self.get_wo_parts(boms_dict)
            bom_parts_dict = self.get_bom_parts(boms_dict)
            mapped_parts_dict = RefreshBomServiced.map_parts(wo_parts_list, bom_parts_dict)
            insert_result = self.update_bom_parts(insert_result, mapped_parts_dict)

            logger.debug(dumps(insert_result, indent=2))

            end_time = datetime.now()
            self.iom_utils.calculate_run_time(start_time, end_time, "refresh_bom_services", insert_result, "refresh_bom_services")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in refresh_bom_services: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

    def get_boms(self):
        boms_dict = {}
        try:
            query = """
                SELECT 
                    b.bom_id, wo.woNumber
                FROM
                    bom_database.boms b
                        LEFT JOIN
                    (SELECT 
                        wo_bom.bomNumber, wo_bom.woNumber
                    FROM
                        matrix.wo_bom
                    JOIN filemaker.wo ON wo.woNumber = wo_bom.woNumber) AS wo ON wo.bomNumber = b.bom_id
                WHERE
                    b.bom_status < 20
                        AND wo.woNumber IS NOT NULL
                """
            results = self.iom_utils.get_pagination_result(query)
            for result in results:
                boms_dict.setdefault(result['bom_id'], []).append(result['woNumber'])
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in get_boms: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return boms_dict

    def get_wo_parts(self, boms_dict):
        wo_parts_list = []
        try:
            wo_numbers = ', '.join(str(value) for sublist in boms_dict.values() for value in sublist)
            query = f"""
                SELECT 
                    c.cifaNumber AS cifa,
                    pl.woNumber AS wo,
                    pl.qtyShipped AS qty,
                    m.modelName AS partName,
                    IF(CHAR_LENGTH(pl.serialNumber) >= 5
                            AND pl.qtyShipped = 1,
                        1,
                        0) AS discoverable,
                    IF((wfa.last_active > NOW() - INTERVAL 3 DAY)
                            AND pl.qtyShipped = 1,
                        1,
                        0) AS onNet
                FROM
                    filemaker.packingList pl
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker.model m ON m.modelId = pl.modelId
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker.fmAssets fa ON fa.assetId = pl.assetId
                        LEFT JOIN
                    filemaker.cifa c ON c.cifaId = fa.cifa
                        LEFT JOIN
                    matrix.wo_fmAssets wfa ON wfa.fm_recordId = fa.recordId
                WHERE
                    pl.woNumber IN ({wo_numbers})
                ORDER BY onNet DESC
                """
            wo_parts_list = self.iom_utils.get_pagination_result(query)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in get_wo_parts: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return wo_parts_list

    def get_bom_parts(self, boms_dict):
        bom_parts_dict = {}
        try:
            bom_numbers = ', '.join(str(bom_number) for bom_number in boms_dict.keys())
            query = f"""
                SELECT 
                    bp.boms_parts_id,
                    bp.boms_parts_count,
                    p.part_number,
                    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pc.cifa) AS cifa
                FROM
                    bom_database.boms_parts bp
                        LEFT JOIN
                    bom_database.parts p ON p.part_id = bp.boms_parts_part
                        LEFT JOIN
                    bom_database.parts_cifa pc ON pc.part_id = p.part_id
                WHERE
                    bp.boms_parts_bom IN ({bom_numbers})
                        AND bp.boms_parts_count > 0
                GROUP BY boms_parts_id
                """
            results = self.iom_utils.get_pagination_result(query)
            for result in results:
                bom_parts_dict[int(result['boms_parts_id'])] = {
                    'cifaList': result['cifa'].split(',') if result['cifa'] else [],
                    'qty': int(result['boms_parts_count']) if result['boms_parts_count'] else 0,
                    'partName': result['part_number'],
                    'counter': 0
                }
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in get_bom_parts: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return bom_parts_dict

    @staticmethod
    def map_parts(wo_parts_list, bom_parts_dict):
        mapped_parts_dict = {}
        try:
            for wo_parts_dict in wo_parts_list:
                wo_qty = wo_parts_dict.get('qty') if wo_parts_dict.get('qty') else 0
                wo_number = wo_parts_dict['wo']
                for part_id in list(bom_parts_dict.keys()):
                    l_wo_part_name = wo_parts_dict['partName'].lower().replace('=', '')
                    l_bom_part_name = bom_parts_dict[part_id]['partName'].lower().replace('=', '')
                    if (wo_parts_dict['cifa'] in bom_parts_dict[part_id]['cifaList'] or (len(l_bom_part_name) >= 5 and l_wo_part_name == l_bom_part_name) or
                            (len(l_bom_part_name) >= 10 and (l_wo_part_name.startswith(l_bom_part_name) or l_bom_part_name.startswith(l_wo_part_name)))):
                        if part_id not in mapped_parts_dict:
                            mapped_parts_dict[part_id] = {}
                        if wo_number not in mapped_parts_dict[part_id]:
                            mapped_parts_dict[part_id][wo_number] = {'serviced': 0, 'onNet': 0, 'discoverable': []}
                        mapped_parts_dict[part_id][wo_number]['discoverable'].append(wo_parts_dict['discoverable'])

                        if bom_parts_dict[part_id]['qty'] >= wo_qty:
                            bom_parts_dict[part_id]['qty'] -= wo_qty
                            mapped_parts_dict[part_id][wo_number]['serviced'] += wo_qty
                            mapped_parts_dict[part_id][wo_number]['onNet'] += wo_parts_dict['onNet']
                            if bom_parts_dict[part_id]['qty'] == 0:

                            wo_qty -= bom_parts_dict[part_id]['qty']
                            mapped_parts_dict[part_id][wo_number]['serviced'] += bom_parts_dict[part_id]['qty']
                            mapped_parts_dict[part_id][wo_number]['onNet'] += wo_parts_dict['onNet']
                            bom_parts_dict.pop(part_id)

class OffnetPreQuarterUsage:
    def __init__(self, iom_utils, start_date):
        self.iom_utils = iom_utils
        self.start_date = start_date
        self.offnet_quarterly_division_table = "bom_database.offnet_quarterly_division"
        self.offnet_quarterly_de_table = "bom_database.offnet_quarterly_de"
        self.offnet_quarterly_manager_table = "bom_database.offnet_quarterly_manager"
        self.offnet_pre_quarter_usage()

    def offnet_pre_quarter_usage(self):
        try:
            start_time = datetime.now()
            util.start()
            quarter_dates = IomUtils.get_quarters_from_start_date(self.start_date)
            insert_result = {}
            insert_result = self.insert_offnet_quarterly_division(quarter_dates, insert_result, self.offnet_quarterly_division_table)
            insert_result = self.insert_offnet_quarterly_de(quarter_dates, insert_result, self.offnet_quarterly_de_table)
            insert_result = self.insert_offnet_quarterly_manager(quarter_dates, insert_result, self.offnet_quarterly_manager_table)
            logger.debug(dumps(insert_result, indent=2))

            end_time = datetime.now()
            self.iom_utils.calculate_run_time(start_time, end_time, "offnet_pre_quarter_usage", insert_result, "offnet_pre_quarter_usage.py")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in offnet_pre_quarter_usage: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

    def insert_offnet_quarterly_division(self, quarter_dates, insert_result, table_name):
        try:
            query_result = []
            for quarter_date in quarter_dates:
                query = f"""
                    SELECT 
                        main.id AS division_id,
                        offnet_asset AS offnet_value,
                        '{quarter_date.get("current_date")}' AS datestamp,
                        '{quarter_date.get("quarter")}' AS quarter
                    FROM
                        (SELECT 
                            d.division_name,
                                d.id,
                                ROUND(SUM(k.assetValue), 2) AS offnet_asset
                        FROM
                            model_kpi k
                        LEFT JOIN filemaker.wo wo ON k.woNumber = wo.woNumber
                        LEFT JOIN filemaker.shipAddress sh ON sh.shipId = wo.shipId
                        LEFT JOIN bom_database.state_division sd ON sd.state = REPLACE(sh.state, '|', '')
                        LEFT JOIN bom_database.bom_divisions d ON d.id = sd.division_id
                        LEFT JOIN bom_database.offnet_asset_plan op ON op.serial_number = k.serialNumber
                        WHERE
                            k.deprecated = 0 AND k.discoverable = 1
                                AND (IF(CHAR_LENGTH(k.serialNumber) > 4
                                AND k.qtyShipped = 1, 1, 0))
                                AND k.dateShipped BETWEEN '{quarter_date.get("start_date")}' AND '{quarter_date.get("end_date")}'
                                AND k.rack IS NULL
                                AND (k.status = 'Inactive'
                                OR k.status IS NULL)
                                AND k.dateShipped < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK)
                                AND k.wo_title NOT LIKE 'ENE%'
                                AND k.wo_title NOT REGEXP '(_|-| |^)ene'
                                AND k.wo_title NOT LIKE '%%ENTERPRISE%%'
                                AND k.woNumber NOT IN (303679 , 304081, 307882, 307889, 315455)
                        GROUP BY d.id) main
                    """
                quarter_data = self.iom_utils.get_pagination_result(query)
                query_result.extend(quarter_data) if quarter_data else query_result

            if query_result:
                insert_result = self.iom_utils.select_and_insert_data(table_name, insert_result, ignore=True, query_result=query_result)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in insert_offnet_quarterly_division: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return insert_result

    def insert_offnet_quarterly_de(self, quarter_dates, insert_result, table_name):
        try:
            query_result = []
            for quarter_date in quarter_dates:
                query = f"""
                    SELECT 
                        main.requestorId AS de_id,
                        offnet_asset AS offnet_value,
                        '{quarter_date.get("current_date")}' AS datestamp,
                        '{quarter_date.get("quarter")}' AS quarter
                    FROM
                        (SELECT 
                            r.requestorId, ROUND(SUM(k.assetValue), 2) AS offnet_asset
                        FROM
                            model_kpi k
                        JOIN filemaker.wo ON wo.woNumber = k.woNumber
                        JOIN filemaker.requestor r ON r.requestorId = wo.requestedBy
                        LEFT JOIN bom_database.offnet_asset_plan op ON op.serial_number = k.serialNumber
                        WHERE
                            k.deprecated = 0 AND k.discoverable = 1
                                AND (IF(CHAR_LENGTH(k.serialNumber) > 4

                                AND k.dateShipped BETWEEN '{quarter_date.get("start_date")}' AND '{quarter_date.get("end_date")}'
                                AND k.rack IS NULL
                                AND (k.`status` = 'Inactive'
                                OR k.`status` IS NULL)
                                AND k.dateShipped < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK)
                                AND k.wo_title NOT LIKE 'ENE%'
                                AND k.wo_title NOT REGEXP '(_|-| |^)ene'
                                AND k.wo_title NOT LIKE '%%ENTERPRISE%%'
                                AND k.woNumber NOT IN (303679 , 304081, 307882, 307889, 315455)
                        GROUP BY r.requestorId) main
                    """
                quarter_data = self.iom_utils.get_pagination_result(query)
                query_result.extend(quarter_data) if quarter_data else query_result

            if query_result:

        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in insert_offnet_quarterly_de: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return insert_result

    def insert_offnet_quarterly_manager(self, quarter_dates, insert_result, table_name):
        try:
            query_result = []
            for quarter_date in quarter_dates:
                query = f"""
                    SELECT 
                        main.manager AS manager_id,
                        offnet_asset AS offnet_value,
                        '{quarter_date.get("current_date")}' AS datestamp,
                        '{quarter_date.get("quarter")}' AS quarter
                    FROM
                        (SELECT 
                            (SELECT 
                                        user_id
                                    FROM
                                        users
                                    WHERE
                                        user_login = u.accountable_manager) AS manager,
                                ROUND(SUM(k.assetValue), 2) AS offnet_asset
                        FROM
                            model_kpi k
                        LEFT JOIN boms b ON b.bom_id = k.bomNumber
                        LEFT JOIN bom_database.users u ON u.user_id = b.bom_author

                        WHERE
                            k.deprecated = 0 AND k.discoverable = 1
                                AND (IF(CHAR_LENGTH(k.serialNumber) > 4
                                AND k.qtyShipped = 1, 1, 0))
                                AND u.user_login NOT IN ('ssarad404' , 'bchand00')
                                AND b.bom_id NOT IN (13156)
                                AND k.wo_title NOT REGEXP '(_|-| |^)ene'
                                AND k.wo_title NOT LIKE '%ENTERPRISE%'
                                AND k.dateShipped < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK)
                                AND u.accountable_manager NOT IN ('DDaign001')
                                AND k.woNumber NOT IN (303679 , 304081, 307882, 307889, 315455)
                                AND k.dateShipped BETWEEN '{quarter_date.get("start_date")}' AND '{quarter_date.get("end_date")}'
                                AND k.rack IS NULL
                                AND (k.status = 'Inactive'

                                AND k.dateShipped < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK)

                                AND k.wo_title NOT REGEXP '(_|-| |^)ene'
                                AND k.wo_title NOT LIKE '%%ENTERPRISE%%'
                                AND k.woNumber NOT IN (303679 , 304081, 307882, 307889, 315455)

        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in insert_offnet_quarterly_manager: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return insert_result

class ResiRer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.iom_utils = IomUtils()
        util.start()

    def remove_archived_resi_bom(self):

        try:
            query = """
                SELECT 
                    bom
                FROM
                    matrix.resi_bom
                WHERE
                    bom > 0
                        AND (rur_count > 0 OR rer_count > 0)
            """
            results = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")

            if results:
                bom_ids = ','.join(map(str, list(set([result.get('bom') for result in results]))))
                query = f"""
                    SELECT 
                        bom_id
                    FROM
                        bom_database.boms b
                    WHERE
                        b.bom_id IN ({bom_ids})
                            AND b.bom_archived IN (1 , 2)
                """
                results = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")

                if results:
                    bom_ids = ','.join(map(str, list(set([result.get('bom_id') for result in results]))))
                    query = f"""
                        UPDATE IGNORE matrix.resi_bom 
                        SET 
                            rur_count = 0,
                            rer_count = 0
                        WHERE
                            bom IN ({bom_ids})
                    """
                    results = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "UPDATE")

                    if results:
                        logger.debug(f"resi_bom_total: {len(results)}, resi_boms: {results}")
                    else:
                        logger.debug(f"Update matrix.resi_bom failed: {results}")
                else:
                    logger.debug("2 - No data found to update")
            else:
                logger.debug("1 - No data found to update")

        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in remove_archived_resi_bom: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

    def sync_up(self):
        try:
            self.remove_archived_resi_bom()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

            data = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "INSERT")
            return data
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

    def date_diff2(self, date1, date2):
        try:
            if date1 is not None and date2 is not None:
                diff = datetime.strptime(str(date2), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f") - datetime.strptime(str(date1), "%Y-%m-%d")
                return round(diff.days)
            else:
                return 0
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

    def get_wh_details_summary(self):
        try:
            sla_array = {
                'NorthEast': {'red': 3, 'yellow_lower': 4, 'yellow_upper': 6, 'green': 7},
                'Central': {'red': 5, 'yellow_lower': 6, 'yellow_upper': 8, 'green': 9},
                'West': {'red': 6, 'yellow_lower': 7, 'yellow_upper': 9, 'green': 10},
                'National (Non-Threshold)': {'red': 4, 'yellow_lower': 5, 'yellow_upper': 7, 'green': 8}
            }

            query = """
                SELECT
                    wb.bomNumber AS bom_id,
                    t.team_name,
                    d.division_name,
                    bpc.budget_clarification,
                    wb.woNumber,
                    w.title,
                    IF(w.expediteOverride = 1, 'Yes', 'No') AS exp,
                    w.dateDue,
                    wb.bomNumber
                FROM
                    cifa.fm_wo_bom wb
                        LEFT JOIN filemaker2.wo w ON w.woNumber = wb.woNumber
                        LEFT JOIN bom_database.boms b ON b.bom_id = wb.bomNumber
                        JOIN bom_database.regions r ON r.region_id = b.bom_region
                        JOIN bom_database.divisions d ON d.division_id = r.region_division
                        JOIN bom_database.teams t ON t.team_id = d.division_team
                        LEFT JOIN bom_database.budget_project_clarification bpc ON bpc.id = b.proj_clar_id and bpc.id in (6,8,12)
                        LEFT JOIN filemaker.woStep s ON s.stepId = w.stepId
                WHERE
                    b.bom_id is not null
                    AND s.stepId NOT IN (3, 1)
                ORDER BY dateDue
            """

            data2 = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")
            logger.debug(data2)
            owners = {'TOTAL': {'red': 0, 'yellow': 0, 'green': 0, 'red_list': '', 'yellow_list': '', 'green_list': ''}}
            owners_step = {}

            for each_row in data2:
                if each_row['team_name'] == 'Transport':
                    if each_row['budget_clarification'] == 'Commercial-Transport':
                        each_row['budget_clarification'] = 'com'
                    elif each_row['budget_clarification'] == 'CRAN-VCMTS-Transport':
                        each_row['budget_clarification'] = 'vcmts'
                    elif each_row['budget_clarification'] == 'CRAN-BAU-Transport':
                        each_row['budget_clarification'] = 'bau'
                    else:
                        each_row['budget_clarification'] = 'others'
                    each_row['team_name'] = f"{each_row['team_name']} ({each_row['budget_clarification']})"

                return_value = self.date_diff2(each_row['dateDue'], datetime.now())
                return_value = -1 * return_value if return_value is not None else 0

                each_row['return_value'] = return_value
                if (owners.get(each_row.get('step_owner'))):
                    owners[each_row.get('step_owner')]['approver_id'] = each_row.get('approver_id')

                if sla_array.get(each_row['division_name']) and return_value <= sla_array[each_row['division_name']]['red']:
                    owners['TOTAL']['red'] += 1
                    owners['TOTAL']['red_list'] += f"{each_row['woNumber']},"
                    if (owners.get(each_row['team_name'])):
                        owners[each_row['team_name']]['red'] += 1
                        owners[each_row['team_name']]['red_list'] += f"{each_row['woNumber']},"
                        owners[each_row['team_name']]['red_list_query'].append(each_row)
                elif sla_array.get(each_row['division_name']) and sla_array[each_row['division_name']]['yellow_lower'] <= return_value <= sla_array[each_row['division_name']]['yellow_upper']:
                    owners['TOTAL']['yellow'] += 1
                    owners['TOTAL']['yellow_list'] += f"{each_row['woNumber']},"
                    if (owners.get(each_row['team_name'])):
                        owners[each_row['team_name']]['yellow'] += 1
                        owners[each_row['team_name']]['yellow_list'] += f"{each_row['woNumber']},"
                        owners[each_row['team_name']]['yellow_list_query'].append(each_row)
                elif sla_array.get(each_row['division_name']) and return_value >= sla_array[each_row['division_name']]['green']:
                    owners['TOTAL']['green'] += 1
                    owners['TOTAL']['green_list'] += f"{each_row['woNumber']},"
                    if (owners.get(each_row['team_name'])):
                        owners[each_row['team_name']]['green'] += 1
                        owners[each_row['team_name']]['green_list'] += f"{each_row['woNumber']},"
                        owners[each_row['team_name']]['green_list_query'].append(each_row)

            results = {'owner_outside': owners}

            return results
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

class ScriptSVCMove:
    def __init__(self):
        self.user_id = 938
        util.start()
        self.iom_utils = IomUtils()
        self.processData()
    def processData(self):
        query = f"""SELECT * FROM bom_database.boms b
                    JOIN bom_database.boms_status bs ON bs.bom_status_id = b.bom_status
                    JOIN bom_database.regions r ON r.region_id = b.bom_region
                    JOIN bom_database.divisions d ON d.division_id = r.region_division
                    JOIN bom_database.teams t ON t.team_id = d.division_team
                    JOIN bom_database.budget_project_clarification bpc ON bpc.id = b.proj_clar_id
                    WHERE (bpc.budget_clarification LIKE '%SVCS%'
                    OR bpc.budget_clarification = 'Services')
                    AND b.bom_status IN (10, 62, 63, 58, 55, 59)
                    AND b.bom_archived NOT IN (1,2)"""
        results = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")
        for r in results:
            bom_id = r['bom_id']
            query = f"""UPDATE bom_database.boms set bom_status = 72, last_update = NOW() where bom_id = {bom_id}"""
            self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "UPDATE")
            payload = {
                            "user": self.user_id,
                            "bom": bom_id,
                            "text": 'Bom moved to service completed status',
                        }
            requests.post(f"{icputils.config.env_configs.get('api_url')}/api/logs/bom_update_status", json=payload, verify=False)

class ScriptPOStatus:

    def __init__(self):
        try:
            self.iom_utils = IomUtils()
            util.start()
            self.user_id = 938

            # Delete records from `po_reach`
            delete_query = "DELETE FROM `bom_database`.`po_reach`"
            self.iom_utils.run_query(delete_query, "DELETE")

            # Fetch data from the database
            select_query = """
                SELECT
                    b.bom_id, _pd.po_number AS own_pos, _th.threshold_pos
                FROM
                    bom_database.boms b
                    LEFT JOIN
                    (SELECT pb.bom_number, GROUP_CONCAT(pb.po_number) AS po_number
                     FROM cifa.po_bom pb
                     JOIN cifa.preq_details pd ON pd.delete_flag = 0 AND pd.preq_number = pb.preq_number
                     WHERE pb.po_number <> 0 GROUP BY pb.bom_number) _pd ON _pd.bom_number = b.bom_id
                    LEFT JOIN
                    (SELECT thres.bom_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT thres.threshold_bom_id) AS threshold_boms,
                            GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT _pd_thres.po_number) AS threshold_pos
                     FROM cifa.bom_threshold_detail thres
                     LEFT JOIN
                     (SELECT pb.bom_number, GROUP_CONCAT(pb.po_number) AS po_number
                      FROM cifa.po_bom pb
                      JOIN cifa.preq_details pd ON pd.delete_flag = 0 AND pd.preq_number = pb.preq_number
                      WHERE pb.po_number <> 0 GROUP BY pb.bom_number) _pd_thres ON _pd_thres.bom_number = thres.threshold_bom_id
                     GROUP BY thres.bom_id) _th ON _th.bom_id = b.bom_id
                WHERE
                    b.bom_status IN (55, 59) AND b.bom_author NOT IN (664, 563, 437)
                    AND b.bom_archived = 0 GROUP BY b.bom_id
            """
            fetch_data = self.iom_utils.run_query(select_query, "SELECT")

            total = ''
            for r in fetch_data:
                full = f"{r['own_pos']},{r['threshold_pos']}"
                inter = ','.join(filter(None, full.split(',')))
                if inter:
                    total += f"{inter},"

            data_load = total.rstrip(',')
            array = data_load.split(",")
            for value in array:
                if (value not in (None, 'None') and len(value) > 0):
                    select_query = f"""
                        SELECT
                            _pi.po_number,
                            fm.poNumber,
                            fm.CIFANumber,
                            IF(fm.totReceivedDisp, fm.totReceivedDisp, 0) AS totReceived,
                            _pi.quantity
                        FROM
                            cifa.po_bom pb
                            JOIN (SELECT pi.po_number, SUM(pi.quantity) AS quantity, pi.cifa_item_number
                                FROM cifa.po_items pi
                                GROUP BY pi.cifa_item_number, pi.po_number
                                HAVING cifa_item_number IS NOT NULL) _pi ON pb.po_number = _pi.po_number
                            LEFT JOIN
                            (SELECT SUM(fm.totReceivedDisp) AS totReceivedDisp, fm.poNumber, fm.CIFANumber
                            FROM cifa.fm_po_line fm
                            GROUP BY fm.poNumber, fm.CIFANumber) fm ON fm.poNumber = _pi.po_number
                                                                        AND fm.CIFANumber = _pi.cifa_item_number
                        WHERE
                            pb.po_number = {value}
                    """
                    res = self.iom_utils.run_query(select_query, "SELECT")
                    counter = 0
                    del_check = 0
                    if (res):
                        for r in res:
                            if r['totReceived'] is not None and r['quantity'] is not None and r['totReceived'] < r['quantity']:
                                counter = 1
                            del_check = 1

                        if counter == 0 and del_check == 1:  # reached
                            insert_query = f"INSERT INTO `bom_database`.`po_reach`(`po`,`status`) VALUES ({value}, 'green') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE  po = VALUES(po)"
                            logger.debug(insert_query)
                            self.iom_utils.run_query(insert_query, "INSERT")
                        else:
                            insert_query = f"INSERT INTO `bom_database`.`po_reach`(`po`,`status`) VALUES ({value}, 'red')  ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE  po = VALUES(po)"
                            logger.debug(insert_query)
                            self.iom_utils.run_query(insert_query, "INSERT")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

                    HAVING (count_mismatch = 1 OR is_rejected = 1

                        OR cifa_mismatch = 1);"""
            get_all_items = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")
            self.run_preq_item_reason(get_all_items)
            query = """

                            poi.line_number as po_line_number,
                            poi.cifa_item_number,
                            poi.mfg_part_number,
                            FLOOR(IFNULL(poi.unit_price, 0)) AS po_unit_price,
                            pob.bom_number,
                            SUM(IFNULL(poi.quantity, 0)) AS po_quantity,
                            SUM(IFNULL(_t_preq_po.quantity, 0)) AS preq_quantity,
                            0 AS is_cancelled,
                            0 AS is_rejected,
                            0 AS count_mismatch,

                            0 AS cifa_mismatch,

                        FROM

                            cifa.po_bom AS pob ON pob.po_number = poi.po_number

                                LEFT JOIN

                                AND pp.po_number <> 0
                                AND IFNULL(pp.preq_number, 0) <> 0
                                LEFT JOIN
                                (SELECT pi.preq_number, pi.supplier_item, pi.cifa_number, pi.line_number,

                                    JOIN cifa.preq_po as pp on pp.preq_number = pi.preq_number) as _t_preq_po

                                LEFT JOIN
                            cifa.preq_details pd ON pd.preq_number = pp.preq_number

                            bom_database.boms b ON b.bom_id = pob.bom_number
                        WHERE

                                AND poi.cifa_item_number IS NOT NULL

    def run_preq_item_reason(self, get_all_items):
        try:
            reason_code = ''
            all_items = []
            for item in get_all_items:

                if item['is_cancelled'] == 1:
                    reason_code = 'R00'
                elif item['is_rejected'] == 1:
                    reason_code = 'R01'
                elif item['count_mismatch'] == 1 and item['price_mismatch'] == 1:
                    reason_code = 'R02'
                elif item['count_mismatch'] == 1:
                    reason_code = 'R03'
                elif item['price_mismatch'] == 1:
                    reason_code = 'R04'
                elif item['po_item_mismatch'] == 1:
                    reason_code = 'R05'
                elif item['cifa_mismatch'] == 1:
                    reason_code = 'R06'
                all_items.append('||' + str(item['preq_number']) + '||' + str(item['preq_line_number']) + '||' + str(item['po_number']) + '||' +
                                 str(item['po_line_number']) + '||' + reason_code + '||' + str(item['supplier_item']) + '||' + str(item['mfg_part_number']))
            current_reasons_query = """
                SELECT concat('||', COALESCE(preq_number,''), '||', COALESCE(preq_line_number,''), '||', COALESCE(po_number,''), 
                        '||', COALESCE(po_line_number,''), '||', COALESCE(reason_code,''), '||', COALESCE(supplier_item,''), '||', COALESCE(mfg_part_number,'')) 
                        as current_reasons 
                        FROM cifa.preq_items_reason;
            """
            current_reasons = self.iom_utils.run_query(current_reasons_query, "SELECT")
            if current_reasons is not None:
                all_current_reasons = [row for row in current_reasons]
            else:
                all_current_reasons = []
            insert_array = [item for item in all_items if item not in all_current_reasons]

            inc = 0

                insert_item = insert_item.split('||')

                    insert_item[1] = insert_item[1] if insert_item[1] is not None and insert_item[1] != 'None' else 'NULL'
                    insert_item[2] = insert_item[2] if insert_item[2] is not None and insert_item[2] != 'None' else 'NULL'
                    insert_item[3] = insert_item[3] if insert_item[3] is not None and insert_item[3] != 'None' else 'NULL'
                    insert_item[4] = insert_item[4] if insert_item[4] is not None and insert_item[4] != 'None' else 'NULL'
                    insert_item[5] = '"' + insert_item[5] + '"' if insert_item[5] is not None and insert_item[5] != 'None' else 'NULL'
                    insert_item[6] = '"' + insert_item[6] + '"' if insert_item[6] is not None and insert_item[6] != 'None' else 'NULL'
                else:
                    continue
                if inc < 100:
                    ins_row_array.append('(' + insert_item[1] + ', ' + insert_item[2] + ', ' + insert_item[5] + ', ' + insert_item[3] +
                                         ', ' + insert_item[4] + ', ' + insert_item[6] + ', ' + insert_item[5] + ')')
                    inc += 1
                else:
                    query = ','.join(ins_row_array)
                    insert_query = 'INSERT INTO cifa.preq_items_reason (preq_number, preq_line_number, supplier_item, po_number, po_line_number, mfg_part_number, reason_code) VALUES' + query + '  ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE  preq_number = VALUES(preq_number)'
                    self.iom_utils.run_query(insert_query, "INSERT")
                    ins_row_array = []
                    inc = 0

            if ins_row_array:
                query = ','.join(ins_row_array)
                insert_query = 'INSERT INTO cifa.preq_items_reason (preq_number, preq_line_number, supplier_item, po_number, po_line_number, mfg_part_number, reason_code) VALUES ' + query + ' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE  preq_number = VALUES(preq_number)'
                self.iom_utils.run_query(insert_query, "INSERT")

            # Processing delete array
            #delete_array = [item for item in all_items if item not in all_current_reasons]

                delete_items[3] =  delete_items[3] if delete_items[3] else 'NULL'

class CifaExtractByPreqNumber:
    def __init__(self):
        util.start()

        self.iom_utils = IomUtils()
        self.cifa_utils = IomUtils(db_name='cifa_db', schema_name='cifa')
        self.cifa_api = CifaAPI(IomUtils, self.cifa_utils)
        self.preq_details_table = f"{self.cifa_utils.schema_name}.preq_details"
        self.preq_items_table = f"{self.cifa_utils.schema_name}.preq_items"
        self.cifa_extract_by_preq_number()

    def cifa_extract_by_preq_number(self):
        try:
            start_time = datetime.now()
            preq_numbers = self.get_preq_numbers()
            preq_details_request = CifaExtractByPreqNumber.get_preq_details_request(preq_numbers)
            insert_result = self.cifa_api.insert_preq_details_and_lines(preq_details_request, self.preq_details_table, self.preq_items_table, False)

            logger.debug(dumps(insert_result, indent=2))
            end_time = datetime.now()

            self.iom_utils.calculate_run_time(start_time, end_time, self.preq_details_table, insert_result, 'cifa_extract_by_preq_number')
            self.iom_utils.calculate_run_time(start_time, end_time, self.preq_items_table, insert_result, 'cifa_extract_by_preq_number')
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Exception occurred in cifa_extract_by_preq_number: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

    def get_preq_numbers(self):
        preq_numbers = []
        try:
            query = f"""
                SELECT 
                    pd.preq_number
                FROM
                    cifa.preq_details pd
                        LEFT JOIN
                    (SELECT 
                        pi.preq_number,
                            CONCAT('$', FORMAT(SUM(pi.quantity * pi.unit_price), 0)) AS preq_amount
                    FROM
                        cifa.preq_items pi
                    GROUP BY pi.preq_number) _preq_price ON _preq_price.preq_number = pd.preq_number
                        LEFT JOIN
                    cifa.po_bom pobom ON pobom.preq_number = pd.preq_number
                        LEFT JOIN
                    cifa.po_workflow pow ON pow.preq_number = pd.preq_number
                        LEFT JOIN
                    bom_database.preq_approval_plan pap ON pap.preq_number = pd.preq_number
                        LEFT JOIN
                    bom_database.preq_approval_plan_log pap_log ON pap.preq_number = pap_log.preq_number
                        AND pap_log.`status` = 'de_proc2_approved'
                        LEFT JOIN
                    cifa.preq_status_history his ON his.preq_number = pd.preq_number
                        LEFT JOIN
                    (SELECT 
                        a.preq_number, a.`action`, a.action_date
                    FROM
                        cifa.preq_status_history a
                    JOIN (SELECT 
                        his2.preq_number, MAX(his2.sequence_id) AS sequence_id
                    FROM
                        cifa.preq_status_history his2
                    GROUP BY his2.preq_number) b ON b.preq_number = a.preq_number
                        AND b.sequence_id = a.sequence_id) _data ON _data.preq_number = pd.preq_number
                        LEFT JOIN
                    cifa.users u ON u.id = his.approver_id
                WHERE
                    pap.preq_number IS NOT NULL
                        AND _data.`action` = 'Approved'
                        AND pd.delete_flag = 0
                        AND (pobom.po_number = 0
                        OR pobom.po_number IS NULL)
                        AND (pow.po_number = 0
                        OR pow.po_number IS NULL)
                GROUP BY pd.preq_number 
                UNION SELECT DISTINCT
                    pobom.preq_number
                FROM
                    cifa.po_bom pobom
                        LEFT JOIN
                    cifa.preq_details pd ON pd.preq_number = pobom.preq_number
                        LEFT JOIN
                    bom_database.boms b ON b.bom_id = pobom.bom_number
                WHERE
                    b.bom_status IN (59 , 55)
                        AND pd.delete_flag = 0
                        AND bom_archived = 0
                UNION 
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    pobom.preq_number
                FROM
                    cifa.po_bom pobom
                        LEFT JOIN
                    cifa.preq_details pd ON pd.preq_number = pobom.preq_number
                        LEFT JOIN
                    bom_database.boms b ON b.bom_id = pobom.bom_number
                WHERE
                    pd.preq_number like '%-%'
            """
            results = self.cifa_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")
            preq_numbers = [result.get('preq_number') for result in results]
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in get_preq_numbers: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return preq_numbers

    @staticmethod
    def get_preq_details_request(preq_numbers):
        request_data = []
        try:
            for preq_number in preq_numbers:
                request_data.append(
                    {
                        "api_name": "PREQDETAILS",
                        "params": {"WSDL ": "", "WSDL": "", "WSDL%20": ""},
                        "data": {
                            "ReportId": CifaAPI.get_report_id('PREQDETAILS'),
                            "ParametersInput": [
                                {
                                    "Name": "REQ_NUM",
                                    "Value": preq_number
                                },
                                {
                                    "Name": "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
                                    "Value": "FileMaker"
                                }
                            ]
                        }
                    }
                )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in get_preq_details_request: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return request_data

class CifaExtractUpdates:
    def __init__(self):
        util.start()

        self.iom_utils = IomUtils()
        self.cifa_utils = IomUtils(db_name='cifa_db', schema_name='cifa')
        self.cifa_api = CifaAPI(IomUtils, self.cifa_utils)
        self.invoice_details_table = f"{self.cifa_utils.schema_name}.invoice_details"
        self.invoice_receipt_table = f"{self.cifa_utils.schema_name}.invoice_receipt"
        self.cifa_extract_updates()

    def cifa_extract_updates(self):
        try:
            start_time = datetime.now()

            self.cifa_invoice_details()
            Receipt(self.iom_utils, self.cifa_utils)

            end_time = datetime.now()

            self.iom_utils.calculate_run_time(start_time, end_time, 'cifa_extract_updates', comment='cifa_extract_updates')
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in cifa_extract_updates: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

    def cifa_invoice_details(self):
        try:
            start_time = datetime.now()

            preq_numbers = self.get_preq_numbers()
            insert_result = self.cifa_api.insert_invoice_details_and_receipt(preq_numbers, self.invoice_details_table, self.invoice_receipt_table)

            logger.debug(dumps(insert_result, indent=2))
            end_time = datetime.now()

            self.iom_utils.calculate_run_time(start_time, end_time, self.invoice_details_table, insert_result, 'cifa_invoice_details')
            self.iom_utils.calculate_run_time(start_time, end_time, self.invoice_receipt_table, insert_result, 'cifa_invoice_details')
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in cifa_invoice_details: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

    def get_preq_numbers(self):
        preq_numbers = []
        try:
            query = f"""
                SELECT 
                    pr.preq_number, pp.po_number
                FROM
                    cifa.preq_po pp
                        JOIN
                    cifa.preq_details pr ON pr.preq_number = pp.preq_number
                        LEFT JOIN
                    cifa.invoice_details id ON id.preq_number = pp.preq_number
                WHERE
                    id.preq_number IS NULL
                        AND pr.status = 'APPROVED'
                GROUP BY pr.preq_number 
                UNION SELECT 
                    preq_number, po_number
                FROM
                    cifa.invoice_details
                WHERE
                    payment_status != 'Paid'
                        AND status = 'Approved'
                        AND type = 'Item'
                GROUP BY po_number , preq_number 
                UNION SELECT 
                    pp.preq_number, pp.po_number
                FROM
                    cifa.preq_po AS pp
                        JOIN
                    (SELECT 
                        pi.line_number,
                            ROUND(SUM(temp_2.received_quantities), 0) AS invoice_received_quanity,
                            SUM(pi.qty_received) AS po_items_received,
                            pi.po_number
                    FROM
                        cifa.po_items AS pi
                    JOIN (SELECT 
                        SUM(cr.net_received) AS received_quantities,
                            cid.po_number,
                            cid.po_line_number
                    FROM
                        cifa.receipts cr
                    JOIN (SELECT 
                        *
                    FROM
                        cifa.invoice_details cid
                    WHERE
                        status = 'APPROVED'
                    GROUP BY cid.receipt_number , cid.po_number , cid.po_line_number) AS cid ON cr.receipt_number = cid.receipt_number
                        AND cid.po_line_number = cr.line_number
                        AND cid.po_number = cr.po_number
                    GROUP BY cr.line_number , cr.po_number) AS temp_2 ON temp_2.po_number = pi.po_number
                        AND temp_2.po_line_number = pi.line_number
                    WHERE
                        pi.qty_received > 0
                    GROUP BY pi.po_number
                    HAVING invoice_received_quanity <> po_items_received) AS temp_1 ON pp.po_number = temp_1.po_number
                GROUP BY pp.po_number
                """
            results = self.cifa_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")
            preq_numbers = [result.get('preq_number') for result in results if result.get('preq_number')]
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in get_preq_numbers: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")
        return preq_numbers

                mod_id = []

                        if model.endswith('EQUAL'):
                            model = model.replace('EQUAL', '')
                        query = f"SELECT * from filemaker.model where CAST(modelName AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8) = CAST(%s AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8)"
                        model_name = self.iom_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT", [(model,)])
                        if model_name and 'modelId' in model_name[0]:
                            model_id = model_name[0]['modelId'] if model_name[0]['modelId'] > 0 else 0
                            mod_id.append(model_id)
                        else:
                            model_id = '0'
                        po = "'" + line_item.get('_kf_POID', 'NULL') + "'"

                        cifa_number = line_item.get('CIFANumber') if line_item.get('CIFANumber') is not None else 'NULL'
                        po_line_item_id = "" + line_item.get('POLineItem_ID', '0') + ""
                        if po_line_item_id != 'NULL':
                            line_list.append(po_line_item_id)
                        unit_price = line_item.get('unit_price', 'NULL') if line_item.get('unit_price') is not None else 'NULL'
                        line_id = line_item.get('line', 'NULL') if line_item.get('line') else 'NULL'
                        item_category = "'" + line_item.get('ItemCategory', 'NULL') + "'" if line_item.get('ItemCategory') is not None else 'NULL'
                        total_received = line_item['totReceived'] if line_item.get('totReceived') else '0'
                        total_available = line_item['totAvailible'] if line_item.get('totAvailible') else '0'
                        total_on_hand = line_item['totOnHand'] if line_item.get('totOnHand') else '0'
                        total_shipped = str(int(line_item['totReceived']) - int(line_item['totOnHand'])) if line_item.get('totReceived') else '0'

                        qty_received_disp = line_item.get('QtyReceived_Disp', 'NULL') if line_item.get('QtyReceived_Disp') else '0'
                        query = "INSERT INTO cifa.fm_po_line (poNumber, dateRun, CIFANumber, ItemCategory, model, PoLineItemID, ExtendedPrice, LineId, Quantity, UnitPrice, totReceived, totOnHand, totShipped, totAvailible, QtyRecievedOracle, totReceivedDisp) values ('?', NOW(), '?', '?', '?', '?', '?', '?', '?', '?', '?', '?', '?', '?', '?', '?') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE dateRun= NOW(), poNumber = VALUES(poNumber), CIFANumber = VALUES(CIFANumber), ItemCategory = VALUES(ItemCategory), model = VALUES(model), PoLineItemID = VALUES(PoLineItemID), ExtendedPrice = VALUES(ExtendedPrice), LineId = VALUES(LineId), Quantity = VALUES(Quantity), UnitPrice = VALUES(UnitPrice), totReceived = VALUES(totReceived), totOnHand = VALUES(totOnHand), totShipped = VALUES(totShipped), totAvailible = VALUES(totAvailible), QtyRecievedOracle = VALUES(QtyRecievedOracle), totReceivedDisp = VALUES(totReceivedDisp)"
                        if cifa_number and line_item.get('POLineItem_ID') and int(line_item.get('POLineItem_ID')) > 0:

        try:
            query = """
                    SELECT 
                        *
                    FROM
                        (SELECT 
                            SUM(quantity) AS quantity_ordered,
                                SUM(qty_received) AS qty_received,
                                pi.po_number,
                                pi.mfg_part_number,
                                cifa_item_number,
                                pi.item_description,

                        GROUP BY pi.po_number , pi.cifa_item_number) AS oracle

                        (SELECT

    def get_po_numbers(self):
        po_numbers = []
        try:
            query = f"""
                SELECT

                FROM
                    cifa.po_details pd
                        JOIN

                        AND pd.po_number <> 0
                        JOIN
                    cifa.preq_details pdd ON pdd.preq_number = pp.preq_number
                        LEFT JOIN
                    cifa.po_bom pb ON pd.po_number = pb.po_number
                        AND pb.po_number <> 0
                        LEFT JOIN
                    bom_database.boms b ON b.bom_id = pb.bom_number

                        OR pd.supplier_name LIKE '%Prolabs%')
                        AND YEAR(pd.order_date) IN (2022 , 2023)
                GROUP BY pd.po_number
            """
            results = self.cifa_utils.run_query(query, "SELECT")
            po_numbers = [result.get('po_number') for result in results]
        except Exception as e:

        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Exception occurred in cifa_invoice_details: {e}, {traceback.format_exc()}")

    def get_preq_numbers(self):
        preq_numbers = []
        try:
            query = f"""
                SELECT 
                    preq_number
                FROM
                    cifa.preq_po
                WHERE
                    po_number IN (SELECT 
                            po_number
                        FROM
                            (SELECT 
                                _po_price.po_price AS po_price,
                                    _po_price.po_received_price AS po_received_price,
                                    _po_price.po_invoiced_price AS po_invoiced_price,
                                    FORMAT(_inv.invoice_amount, 0) AS invoice_amount,
                                    po.po_number,
                                    pd.order_date,
                                    _inv.timestamp,
                                    prp.preq_number
                            FROM
                                cifa.po_items po
                            JOIN cifa.po_details pd ON pd.po_number = po.po_number
                            JOIN cifa.preq_po pp ON pp.po_number = po.po_number
                            JOIN cifa.preq_details prp ON prp.preq_number = pp.preq_number
                            JOIN (SELECT 
                                FORMAT(SUM(po.quantity * po.unit_price), 0) AS po_price,
                                    FORMAT(SUM(po.unit_price * po.qty_received), 0) AS po_received_price,
                                    FORMAT(SUM(po.unit_price * po.qty_invoiced), 0) AS po_invoiced_price,
                                    po.po_number
                            FROM
                                cifa.po_items po
                            GROUP BY po.po_number) _po_price ON _po_price.po_number = pd.po_number
                            LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
                                SUM(id.amount) AS invoice_amount, id.po_number, timestamp
                            FROM
                                cifa.invoice_details id
                            WHERE
                                po_line_number IS NOT NULL
                            GROUP BY id.po_number) _inv ON _inv.po_number = po.po_number
                            WHERE
                                pd.po_status = 'Approved'
                                    AND prp.status = 'Approved'
                                    AND pd.project_number IN (SELECT 
                                        project_number
                                    FROM
                                        cifa.projects)
                                    AND prp.delete_flag = 0
                            GROUP BY po.po_number
                            HAVING FORMAT(po_invoiced_price, 0) != FORMAT(invoice_amount, 0)) _inner)
                """

        self.iom_utils = iom_utils
        self.cifa_utils = cifa_utils

    def receipt(self):
        try:
            start_time = datetime.now()

            preq_numbers = self.get_receipt_details()
            print(preq_numbers)
            
            po_receipt_details_request = Receipt.get_po_receipt_details_request(preq_numbers)

            po_receipt_details = IomUtils.start_thread(self.cifa_api.get_po_receipt_details, po_receipt_details_response)
